programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk and the television star / Mr. Monk und der Fernsehstar
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A cruel violent crime is done on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. In order to clear it up, the London investigator Richard Poole is put on the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but at all it cannot make friends with the Caribbean mentality. This always ensures entertaining situations. The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like the sea fruit. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Basketball - Serbian League / Košarka - Srpska liga
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest rank of baseball league in North America. League beginners already before the end of the 19th century, in 1876. When the first season of the Netherlands' first season was played. In 1903. Today's structure was formed with the first edition of "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 matches. Out of a total of eight teams that select the Plejof two best play "World Series Final". The winner is the one who arrives first to four victories in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.desc: Eran's father is mayor and warns his son to be careful about what kind of friends he communicates. Investigator David meets Eran and realizes that he is not at school. Чино предупреждава Давиди, че по новините са го показали как бие бащата на едно от децата, които разследва. А всъщност той е защитавал сина от агресивния баща. Отстраняват го. Еран казва на Еднорога, че Давиди го е видял в къщата на Дор. Затова предлага да го убият, но Еднорога отказва и го съветва само да се отърве от пистолета. Давиди разбира, че Итамар спи в пицарията, защото се страхува от баща си. Веднъж вече го е спасявал от пияния му баща. А сега завежда момчето в дома си. He is lying to him for temperature. As he takes him home, they talk. Chino warns David that on the news, he was shown how the father of one of the children he investigated was beaten. In fact, he defended the son from the aggressive father. They remove it. Eran tells the Unicorn that Davidi saw him in Dor's house. So he proposes to kill him, but unicorn refuses and only advises him to get rid of the gun. Davidi realizes that Itamar is sleeping in the pizzeria because he is afraid of his father. He once saved him from his drunken father. And now he takes the boy to his home. His wife, Miri, worries that Davidi is beginning to lose control. / Бащата на Еран е кмет и предупреждава сина си да внимава с какви приятели общува. Следовател Давиди среща Еран и разбира, че не е на училище. Той го лъже, че е с температура. Докато го откарва вкъщи, разговарят. Чино предупреждава Давиди, че по новините са го показали как бие бащата на едно от децата, които разследва. А всъщност той е защитавал сина от агресивния баща. Отстраняват го. Еран казва на Еднорога, че Давиди го е видял в къщата на Дор. Затова предлага да го убият, но Еднорога отказва и го съветва само да се отърве от пистолета. Давиди разбира, че Итамар спи в пицарията, защото се страхува от баща си. Веднъж вече го е спасявал от пияния му баща. А сега завежда момчето в дома си. Съпругата му Мири се тревожи, че Давиди започва да губи контрол.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Another death is added to the investigation. But whether it is a suicide or an accident, they do not know. They allow an overdose that made the boy drowned. But he was a swimmer. There were antidepressants and a cure for hallucinations in his blood. The family refuses an autopsy. Natalie and Guy believe that Tom has escaped because of the three who were in the hallway one is dead, she is forever in a stroller, only he remains. His mother is desperate and regrets that she was blind to his depression, anxiety and loneliness. Miri goes to the hospital. They talk to Davidi, who regrets that he was not with her. She is not angry, but states that he will always be the baby's father, even if he is not ready or does not like it. Miraculously, police were at school when Tom died. Someone entered the Hanoch's office and he is convinced that he is David for revengeing him. The investigator tells him that he knows he has hidden that Ido has committed suicide. Hanoch justifies that another family is involved. / Към разследването се прибавя още една смърт. Но дали е самоубийство или инцидент, не знаят. Допускат свръхдоза, заради която момчето се е удавило. Но той е бил плувец. В кръвта му е имало антидепресанти и лекарство срещу халюцинации. Семейството отказва аутопсия. Натали и Гай смятат, че Том се е измъкнал, защото от тримата, които са били в коридора единият е мъртъв, тя е завинаги в количка, остава само той. Неговата майка е отчаяна и съжалява, че е била сляпа за депресията му, тревогата и самотата. Мири постъпва в болница. Разговарят с Давиди, който съжалява, че не е бил с нея. Тя не се сърди, но заявява, че той винаги ще бъде баща на бебето, дори да не е готов или да не му харесва. По чудо полицията е била в училището, когато Том е умрял. Някой е влизал в кабинета на Ханох и той е убеден, че е Давиди, че му отмъщава. Следователят му казва, че знае, че е скрил, че Идо се е самоубил. Ханох се оправдава, че е замесено и друго семейство.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

Екипът търси по-бързи и ефективни начини за залесяване.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Boncho Genchev / Зала на славата: Бончо Генчев
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Davidi officially accuses Eran of killing 5 children and arrested him. He thinks he wanted to take revenge on Ido's death. The inspector tells him of the first three killed children, about entering the tunnel, about dressing up, about printed pistols, but there is one question. What happened there, down, and why Dor Oon killed. The interrogation lasts for a long time, but Eran denies everything. He states that he will not speak anymore without his father, the mayor. But Davidi realizes that they are planning something and Eran follows his watch. Immediately they have to find the video operator. In the rubber, the inspector realizes that this is the girl Libby. Police are looking for her immediately, finding that her parents have been in Kenya for two months. They follow Itar's phone, it turns out to be in the school. They are all there at a mask ball and they will kill Libby. Rousseau wants to take her out. The last action begins. Miri gives birth. / Давиди официално обвинява Еран в убийството на 5 деца и го арестува. Смята, че е искал да си отмъсти за смъртта на Идо. Инспекторът му разказва за първите три убити деца, за влизането в тунела, за преобличането, за принтираните пистолети, но има един въпрос. Какво се е случило там, долу, и защо е убил Дор Орон. Разпитът продължава дълго, но Еран отрича всичко. Заявява, че няма да говори повече без баща си, кмета. Но Давиди разбира, че планират нещо и Еран следи часовника си. Веднага гтрябва да открият оператора на видеото. По гуменките инспекторът разбира, че това е момичето Либи. Полицията веднага я търси, установява, че родителите й от два месеца са в Кения. Проследяват телефона на Итамар, оказва се че е в училището. Всички са там на маскен бал и ще убият Либи. Русо иска да я изведе. Започва последната акция. Мири ражда.

programme.title: Real Madrid - Arsenal, Football, Champions League / Real Madrid - Arsenal, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a Champion Cup was established, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Annas Erbe
programme.desc: Anna Ingstrup (Jutta Speidel) and her husband Christian (Dietrich Hollinderbaumer) drove the family -owned apple yard in the old country near Hamburg with a lot of vigor and passion. It wasn't too long ago that the plotting of Anna's illegitimate daughter Ines (Susanne Schafer) had put the happily marriage of the two in danger. Just when the situation seems to have normalized again, fate strikes again: Christian is completely surprising from a heart attack. A world collapses for Anna. In addition to the loss of her beloved man, she is faced with the challenge in the middle of the harvest time to drive the business on the Grand Hof alone. In her grief she fell to work. Ines quickly realizes that her mother is strong, but in truth, it is hopelessly overwhelmed. In order to be at least while harvesting, she moves to Anna to the apple yard with her 16-year daughter Jo (Anna Hausburg). However, what was meant well will soon lead to tensions, because the relationship between the two women is still difficult. Basically, Anna would like to be alone again. Until Jo entrusts her a secret: just like her grandmother, the teenager is unintentionally pregnant. She doesn't know if she wants to get the child, but shouldn't find out about it. Anna does everything possible to help her granddaughter. During the unsuspecting ines, the administration of the apple courtyard, Anna tries to obtain her granddaughter to get the baby. Of course, it doesn't take long for the secret to come to light. Ines feels exchanged by her daughter and mother. Although Anna only wanted the best, she suddenly got between all fronts. / Mit viel Elan und Leidenschaft fuhren Anna Ingstrup (Jutta Speidel) und ihr Ehemann Christian (Dietrich Hollinderbaumer) den familieneigenen Apfelhof im Alten Land nahe Hamburg. Es ist noch nicht allzu lange her, da hatte das plotzliche Auftauchen von Annas unehelicher Tochter Ines (Susanne Schafer) die gluckliche Ehe der beiden in Gefahr gebracht. Gerade als die Situation sich wieder normalisiert zu haben scheint, schlagt das Schicksal erneut zu: Vollig uberraschend stirbt Christian an einem Herzinfarkt. Fur Anna bricht eine Welt zusammen. Neben dem Verlust ihres geliebten Mannes steht sie mitten in der Erntezeit vor der Herausforderung, die Geschafte auf dem groSSen Hof alleine zu fuhren. In ihrer Trauer sturzt sie sich in die Arbeit. Ines erkennt schnell, dass ihre Mutter sich zwar stark gibt, in Wahrheit aber hoffnungslos uberfordert ist. Um ihr wenigsten wahrend der Erntezeit beizustehen, zieht sie mit ihrer 16-jahrigen Tochter Jo (Anna Hausburg) zu Anna auf den Apfelhof. Was gut gemeint war, fuhrt jedoch schon bald zu Spannungen, denn das Verhaltnis der beiden Frauen ist noch immer schwierig. Im Grunde ware Anna am liebsten wieder alleine. Bis Jo ihr ein Geheimnis anvertraut: Genau wie einst ihre GroSSmutter ist die Teenagerin ungewollt schwanger. Sie weiSS nicht, ob sie das Kind bekommen will, auf keinen Fall aber soll ihre Mutter davon erfahren. Anna setzt alles daran, ihrer Enkelin zu helfen. Wahrend die arglose Ines sich mit der Verwaltung des Apfelhofs abmuht, versucht Anna, ihre Enkelin zu uberzeugen, das Baby zu bekommen. Es dauert naturlich nicht lange, bis das Geheimnis ans Licht kommt. Ines fuhlt sich von ihrer Tochter und ihrer Mutter getauscht und hintergangen. Obwohl Anna nur das Beste wollte, gerat sie auf einmal zwischen alle Fronten.

Allerdings gabe es da ein passendes Motiv: Auch sie mochte Dirndl-Designerin werden und ein Geschaft eroffnen. programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: In the Palinger Heide, a jogger fell on the body of the 39-year-old Franziska Hoven. She died on the back of the head after a blow. However, the site is not the scene of the crime. Initial studies show that the dead man was transported in her husband's car, but the husband has been in a coma for weeks after a serious accident, reports the 18-year daughter Lilly Hoven. Her stepmother Franziska, the dead man, wanted to have the life -supporting measures stopped soon, which not only has very empathetical. Finn and Lars review the recordings of the surveillance camera from the Garage of the Hoven family. They clearly show who drove the car on the night of the crime: Lilly's brother Matze. In the commissioner, the interrogation of the alleged tater begins until the lawyer has interrupted the healing. Sebastian Hoven of all people, Matzes Eisigier Zwillingsbruder, represents the suspect. What the two of them then pretend is the most crazed and clogged plan that the investigators and the public prosecutor ever belonged to. If the two get through with it, the murder would remain unpunished. / Eine Joggerin stoSSt in der Palinger Heide auf die Leiche der 39-jahrigen Franziska Hoven. Sie starb an einem Genickbruch nach einem Schlag auf den Hinterkopf. Allerdings ist der Fundort nicht der Tatort. Erste Untersuchungen ergeben, dass die Tote im Wagen ihres Ehemanns transportiert wurde.Doch der Ehemann liegt nach einem schweren Unfall seit Wochen im Koma, berichtet die 18-jahrige Tochter Lilly Hoven. Ihre Stiefmutter Franziska, die Tote, wollte die lebenserhaltenden MaSSnahmen bald einstellen lassen, was nicht nur Lilly sehr emport hat. Finn und Lars uberprufen die Aufnahmen der Überwachungskamera aus der Garage von Familie Hoven. Sie zeigen deutlich, wer das Auto in der Tatnacht gefahren hat: Lillys Bruder Matze. Im Kommissariat beginnt die Vernehmung des mutmaSSlichen Taters, bis dessen Anwalt das Verhor unterbricht. Ausgerechnet Sebastian Hoven, Matzes eineiigier Zwillingsbruder, vertritt den Verdachtigen. Was die beiden dann prasentieren, ist der verruckteste und ausgeklugeltste Plan, den die Ermittler und die Staatsanwaltin je gehort haben. Sollten die beiden damit durchkommen, bliebe der Mord straffrei.

programme.title: Hallervorden
programme.sub-title: Didi against the rest of the world / Didi gegen den Rest der Welt
programme.desc: Dieter Hallervorden - one of the last icons of German show culture, will be 90 years old on September 5, 2025. The last big fool of the republic. A life between salmon and trannies, between scandal and applause. The man behind "Nonstop Nonsens", behind "Didi - the double ganger", behind "honey in the head" - and behind a life's work that makes millions laugh. He is also one of the most controversial, uncomfortable and most contradictory artists in Germany. A crowd favorite that keeps teasing. The provocateur, who does not become a must, against the expectations of the spectators, against prejudices and - perhaps most - against himself. Get three own theater. Produces songs. Flies daring looping over his hometown. And continues to make headlines - most recently when he sued Chancellor Friedrich Merz for Ubler. Because Hallervorden still does not leave anything like that - neither in politics nor in life. His Berliner at home. His legendary private island in Brittany. He accompanies Hallervorden on rehearsals, when traveling, in front of appearances - and catches up moments in which even one like him can no longer avoid. For the first time, his family has their say in detail - directly, honestly, deeply personal. Nathalie Hallervorden - the daughter with Rotraud Schindler - and his significantly young son Johannes bring us the family man Hallervorden, whose values ​​and beliefs are not always compatible with those of their own generation. worked, argued, laughed and suffered. They draw the picture of a man who has been fighting for over seven decades - against everyone who did not trust him, thought he was free of talent. Against those who misunderstand him to this day or reduce it to his Didi role. The film shows Hallervorden at the big turning points of his eventful life: from childhood in Dessau about the dramatic flight from the GDR -including the never -time plan to murder the regimenian Walter Ulbricht -, about the rise with "Nonsenzen", the cinema year with didi As a slapstick action hero of the 80s, the scandals, the jerking, the comebacks until the spade triumph as a character actor in "his last race" and "honey in the head" and beyond. Because the man who never came to rest runs three theaters to this day, plays several roles at the same time and regularly ensures discussions - whether with provocative groybling, political songs or current eclats. Who wants to understand why someone who once planned an assassination attempt on the GDR regime, even with 90, still politically tackled and loudly expects loss of losses here: Every reason kept throwing the old preserved - and reinventing itself. Why he needs the applause - and yet escapes in front of him. Why he prefers to be teased than to be quiet to this day. The film grits deeply in the archives: 70 years of German show history come to life. Private recordings and TV shaft that no one has seen for decades. Sketches, songs, films, interviews that have shaped whole generations. "Hallervorden" is not a nostalgic jerk view, but a film about fighting. Then as now. About a man who has not stopped rubbing to rub himself - in the world, in society, in itself. A film that explains why Dieter Hallervorden became what he is - and why he is still loved and yet avoided. / Dieter Hallervorden - eine der letzten Ikonen der deutschen Showkultur, wird am 5. September 2025 90 Jahre alt. Der letzte groSSe Narr der Republik. Ein Leben zwischen Lachsalven und Tranen, zwischen Skandal und Applaus. Der Mann hinter "Nonstop Nonsens", hinter "Didi - Der Doppelganger", hinter "Honig im Kopf" - und hinter einem Lebenswerk, das Millionen zum Lachen bringt. Er ist zugleich einer der streitbarsten, unbequemsten und widerspruchlichsten Kunstler Deutschlands. Ein Publikumsliebling, der immer wieder aneckt. Der Provokateur, der nicht mude wird, sich gegen die Erwartungen der Zuschauer, gegen Vorurteile und - vielleicht am meisten - gegen sich selbst zu stemmen.Mit 90 Jahren steht er noch immer auf der Buhne. Fuhrt drei eigene Theater. Produziert Songs. Fliegt waghalsige Looping uber seiner Heimatstadt. Und sorgt weiterhin fur Schlagzeilen - zuletzt, als er den Kanzler Friedrich Merz wegen ubler Nachrede verklagte. Denn Hallervorden lasst bis heute nichts einfach so stehen - weder in der Politik noch im Leben.Der Film offnet Turen, die bisher verschlossen waren: Seine Kunstlergarderobe. Sein Berliner Zuhause. Seine legendare Privatinsel in der Bretagne. Er begleitet Hallervorden bei Proben, auf Reisen, vor Auftritten - und fangt Momente ein, in denen selbst einer wie er nicht mehr ausweichen kann. Zum ersten Mal kommt seine Familie ausfuhrlich zu Wort - direkt, ehrlich, zutiefst personlich. Nathalie Hallervorden - die gemeinsame Tochter mit Rotraud Schindler - und sein deutlich jungerer Sohn Johannes bringen uns den Familienvater Hallervorden naher, dessen Werte und Überzeugungen nicht immer mit denen ihrer eigenen Generation kompatibel sind.Dazu kommen enge langjahrige und prominente Weggefahrten, Vertraute, Beobachter und seine Ehefrau Christiane - die Dieter Hallervorden so gut kennt wie kaum jemand sonst. Menschen, die mit ihm gearbeitet, gestritten, gelacht und gelitten haben. Sie zeichnen das Bild eines Mannes, der seit uber sieben Jahrzehnten kampft - gegen alle, die ihm nichts zutrauten, ihn fur talentfrei hielten, ihn ablehnten. Gegen die, die ihn bis heute missverstehen, verurteilen oder auf seine Didi-Rolle reduzieren.Der Film zeigt Hallervorden an den groSSen Wendepunkten seines bewegten Lebens: Von der Kindheit in Dessau uber die dramatische Flucht aus der DDR - samt dem nie ausgefuhrten Plan, den Regimefuhrer Walter Ulbricht zu ermorden -, uber den Aufstieg mit "Nonstop Nonsens", die Kinojahre mit Didi als Slapstick-Actionheld der 80er Jahre, die Skandale, die Ruckzuge, die Comebacks bis zum spaten Triumph als Charakterdarsteller in "Sein letztes Rennen" und "Honig im Kopf" - und daruber hinaus. Denn der Mann, der nie zur Ruhe kam, fuhrt bis heute drei Theater, produziert, spielt mehrere Rollen gleichzeitig und sorgt regelmaSSig fur Diskussionen - ob mit provokanten Buhnenstucken, politischen Songs oder aktuellen Eklats.Wer verstehen will, warum jemand, der einst ein Attentat auf das DDR-Regime plante, auch mit 90 noch politisch aneckt und seine Meinung lautstark ohne Rucksicht auf Verluste kundtut, bekommt hier Antworten: Warum er bis heute gegen jede Vernunft das altbewahrte immer wieder umschmeiSSt - und sich neu erfindet. Warum er den Applaus braucht - und doch vor ihm fluchtet. Warum er bis heute lieber aneckt als leise zu werden.Der Film grabt tief in den Archiven: 70 Jahre deutsche Showgeschichte werden lebendig. Private Aufnahmen und TV-Schatze, die seit Jahrzehnten niemand mehr gesehen hat. Sketche, Songs, Filme, Interviews, die ganze Generationen gepragt haben."Hallervorden" ist kein nostalgischer Ruckblick, sondern ein Film uber Kampfe. Damals wie heute. Über einen Mann, der bis heute nicht aufhort, sich zu reiben - an der Welt, an der Gesellschaft, an sich selbst. Ein Film, der erklart, warum Dieter Hallervorden zu dem wurde, was er ist - und warum er bis heute so geliebt und doch gemieden wird.

programme.title: Sein letztes Rennen
programme.desc: Paul Averhoff was once a great marathon, a legend, winner of the gold medal in Sydney in 1958. The craft hour has to decide, the crucial question comes up: that should have been? In order not to fall into deep depression, Paul attracts his old racing shoes and begins to run in the park. In the old people's home, the process is confused, but then Margot dies, whereupon Paul dies into deep grief. Can he still have the promise that his wife wrested him shortly before her death? That he will end his race without them, continued to run, unstoppable, out of the sad thoughts, towards the marathon. For himself, but also for all those who he might prove it - his daughter Birgit, his roommates, an entire city ... / Paul Averhoff war einst ein groSSer Marathonlaufer, eine Legende, Gewinner der Goldmedaille in Sydney 1958. Jetzt, mit weit uber 70, zieht er nach wiederholten Sturzen seiner Frau Margot nach vielen glucklichen Jahren aus dem vertrauten Zuhause aus - auch weil Tochter Birgit sich nicht kummern kann, sie jettet als Flugbegleiterin durch die ganze Welt.Im Altersheim, wo Paul sich plotzlich zwischen Singkreis und Bastelstunde entscheiden muss, drangt sich die entscheidende Frage auf: Das soll es gewesen sein? Um nicht in tiefe Depression zu verfallen, zieht Paul seine alten Rennschuhe an und beginnt, im Park zu laufen. Anfangs schleppend und jammerlich, dann aber immer schneller. Seine Heim-Mitbewohner halten ihn fur verruckt, zumal er behauptet, fur den Berlin-Marathon zu trainieren und ihn auch gewinnen zu wollen.Als sich Margot dazu uberreden lasst, ihn wie fruher mit strenger Hand zu trainieren, und Paul in einem Rennen gegen den jungen Pfleger Tobias gewinnt, schlagt die Zuruckhaltung der Bewohner jedoch in Begeisterung um. Die "truben Tassen" werden wieder lebhaft, sie erinnern sich an ihren Helden aus vergangenen Tagen, feiern mit ihm und feuern ihn an. Im Altersheim geraten die Ablaufe durcheinander.Dann aber stirbt Margot, woraufhin Paul in tiefe Trauer verfallt. Kann er das Versprechen noch einlosen, das seine Frau ihm kurz vor ihrem Tod abgerungen hat? Dass er sein Rennen auch ohne sie zu Ende bringen wird, immer weiter lauft, unaufhaltsam, heraus aus den traurigen Gedanken, in Richtung Marathon. programme.desc: Hubert and Staller find a saddled but riderless horse on the side of the road. programme.title: Knowledge before eight earth / Wissen vor acht - Erde
programme.sub-title: How sustainable is wood? / Wie nachhaltig ist Holz?
programme.desc: Wood is enjoying increasing popularity as a renewable and sustainable raw material. The EU calls for the use of wood, which is burned in large quantities as a renewable energy source. Other industries also rely on wood, but this increases our global wood requirements and the forest dangerously. So how can wood be a sustainable raw material? More on this with "Knowledge before eight - earth". / Holz erfreut sich als nachwachsender und nachhaltiger Rohstoff zunehmender Beliebtheit. Die EU fordert die Nutzung von Holz, das in groSSen Mengen als erneuerbare Energiequelle verbrannt wird. Auch andere Industrien setzen verstarkt auf Holz, was jedoch unseren globalen Holzbedarf erhoht und die Walder gefahrdet. Wie kann Holz also ein nachhaltiger Rohstoff sein? Mehr dazu bei "Wissen vor acht - Erde".

programme.title: Shut Up, Bitch!
programme.desc: Wie gerat ein junger Mensch in den Bann frauenfeindlicher Online-Ideologien? Die ARD-Dokumentation taucht tief ein in ein Netzwerk aus YouTubern, Influencern und TikTok-Kanalen, die mit aggressiver Mannlichkeitsrhetorik Millionen junger Manner erreichen. Der Film begleitet zwei junge Menschen, deren Leben und politische Einstellungen sich durch die Inhalte dieser Parallelwelt entscheidend verandert haben, und macht deutlich, mit welcher Dynamik diese Netzwerke agieren. Hinter deren Erfolg stehen nicht nur Algorithmen, die diese Inhalte nach vorne spulen, sondern auch wirtschaftliche Interessen und eine politische Strategie. Die Dokumentation zeigt, wie frauenfeindliche Narrative gezielt fur Wahlkampfe genutzt werden - und weshalb sie eine wachsende Gefahr fur die Gleichberechtigung und die Demokratie darstellen.

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.sub-title: FuSSballprofi Benjamin Henrichs - Vom Verletzungsschock zum Comeback-Traum
programme.desc: Millions see this football evening shortly before Christmas 2024, as he collapses. Benjamin Henrichs, RB Leipzig-Profi and German international, lies on the lawn and cries. His Achilles tendon is torn. Just like that. After a bang as loud as a lash. Without an opponent having to go. At the end of the top game against Bavaria Munchen, which RB Leipzig loses high, Sanitter has to carry the 28-year-old floodlights. A light that Benjamin Henrich has known since the beginning of his steep career. Thousands of fans and followers praise Henrich's player to heaven when he conjures up the ball, or have it when a game goes wrong. This light is sophisticated, Benjamin Henrichs simply a person who suffers and has doubts. Can I play again at some point? Who am I without football? Who is really to me? A tear of the Achilles tendon is considered one of the worst injuries that an athlete can have. The healing process is complicated. Output uncertain. Benjamin Henrichs tries to at least gain control over part of his life. He begins to document his injury and the healing process in film. With the help of his sister Tabea, who has often stood in her brother's shadow, a very personal insight is created. "Faith Over Fear" calls you the documentary that is intended for his followers. In German: Faith overflows fear. It deals with his injury, his belief in God and his struggle, to be able to play again. Maybe in the new season. At the latest for the 2026 World Cup, he wants to stand on the pitch again. The last word of whether his comeback dream will go into fulfillment, neither he nor any coach, Benjamin Henrichs is certain. Questions about your own life, the meaning of the whole and about what really pays: people who are close to us who only see us. No matter what status we have. / Millionen sehen an diesem FuSSballabend kurz vor Weihnachten 2024, wie er zusammenbricht. Benjamin Henrichs, RB-Leipzig-Profi und deutscher Nationalspieler, liegt auf dem Rasen und weint. Seine Achillessehne ist gerissen. Einfach so. Nach einem Knall so laut wie ein Peitschenhieb. Ohne dass ihn ein Gegner beruhrt hat. Am Ende des Spitzenspiels gegen Bayern Munchen, das RB Leipzig haushoch verliert, mussen Sanitater den 28-Jahrigen aus dem gleiSSenden Flutlicht tragen.Ein Licht, das Benjamin Henrichs seit Beginn seiner steilen Karriere kennt. Tausende Fans und Follower loben den Spieler Henrichs in den Himmel, wenn er mit dem Ball zaubert, oder haten ihn, wenn ein Spiel danebengeht. Plotzlich ist dieses Licht aus, Benjamin Henrichs einfach ein Mensch, der leidet und Zweifel hat. Kann ich irgendwann wieder spielen? Wer bin ich ohne FuSSball? Wer halt wirklich zu mir?Ein Riss der Achillessehne gilt als eine der schlimmsten Verletzungen, die ein Sportler haben kann. Der Heilungsprozess ist kompliziert. Ausgang ungewiss. Benjamin Henrichs versucht, zumindest uber einen Teil seines Lebens die Kontrolle zu gewinnen. Er beginnt, sich, seine Verletzung und den Heilungsprozess filmisch zu dokumentieren. Mit Hilfe seiner Schwester Tabea, die oft im Schatten ihres Bruders gestanden hat, entsteht ein sehr personlicher Einblick."Faith over Fear" nennen sie die Dokumentation, die fur seine Follower bestimmt ist. Zu Deutsch: Glaube uberwindet Angst. Darin geht es um seine Verletzung, seinen Glauben an Gott und seinen Kampf, wieder spielen zu konnen. Vielleicht in der neuen Saison. Spatestens zur WM 2026 will er wieder auf dem Platz stehen. Das letzte Wort daruber, ob sein Comeback-Traum in Erfullung gehen wird, haben weder er noch irgendein Trainer, ist sich Benjamin Henrichs sicher.In der "Echtes-Leben"-Reportage spricht der glaubige Christ offen uber seinen Glauben und stellt sich inmitten seiner Krise groSSen Fragen, die uns alle angehen. Fragen nach dem eigenen Lebensweg, dem Sinn des Ganzen und nach dem, was wirklich zahlt: Menschen, die uns nahestehen, die nur uns sehen. Egal, welchen Status wir haben.

programme.title: For always in the heart / Fur immer im Herzen
programme.desc: The attractive publishing manager Julia Berger (Natalia Worner) apparently has everything you can wish for: a responsible profession, a likeable friend, a chic apartment and a racy sports car. However, what she doesn't have is a private life. This gets both her long-term friend Fred (Horst-Gunter Marx) traces and her family, whom she has hardly any contact. The relationship with her father Richard (Hanns Zischler) is very distant, and her younger sister Isabell (Julia Jager) suffers from never having a professional success like Julia. Only for her ten -year -old nephew Stefan (Patrick Baehr) Julia has a very close relationship. It is all the more shocked when one day it turns out that Stefan has a severe form of bone cancer. The boy is admitted to a children's clinic where the treating doctor Dr. Boppard (Hannes Jaenicke) takes on both the children and the members with a lot of empathy overmoth. However, it doesn't take long for the mentally unstable Isabell to no longer grow to emotional pressure. After a nervous break, she is looking for help in a clinic. However, her professional career suffers from this. Julia will soon be presented to the publisher before choosing: does she continue to take out her fuid position or increasingly devote herself to her private environment? For the first time, self -confident Julia threatens to lose control over her life. When she gets little later with her sister, at the same time saves an important merger wife of her publisher, and little Stefan is released from the hospital with good forecasts, everything seems to be turning. But just when Julia full of self -confidence discusses her further career with her CEO, the news arrives that Stefan's condition has suddenly deteriorated. / Die attraktive Verlagsleiterin Julia Berger (Natalia Worner) hat scheinbar alles, was man sich nur wunschen kann: einen verantwortungsvollen Beruf, einen sympathischen Freund, eine schicke Wohnung und einen rassigen Sportwagen. Was sie jedoch nicht hat, ist ein Privatleben. Das bekommt sowohl ihr Dauerfreund Fred (Horst-Gunter Marx) zu spuren als auch ihre Familie, zu der sie kaum noch Kontakt hat. Das Verhaltnis zu ihrem Vater Richard (Hanns Zischler) ist sehr distanziert, und ihre jungere Schwester Isabell (Julia Jager) leidet darunter, nie einen beruflichen Erfolg wie Julia erlangt zu haben. Einzig zu ihrem zehnjahrigen Neffen Stefan (Patrick Baehr) hat Julia ein sehr enges Verhaltnis. Umso schockierter ist sie, als sich eines Tages herausstellt, dass Stefan an einer schweren Form von Knochenkrebs erkrankt ist. Der Junge wird in eine Kinderklinik eingewiesen, wo sich der behandelnde Arzt Dr. Boppard (Hannes Jaenicke) mit viel Einfuhlungsvermogen sowohl der Kinder als auch der Angehorigen annimmt. Es dauert jedoch nicht lange, bis die psychisch labile Isabell dem emotionalen Druck nicht mehr gewachsen ist. Nach einem Nervenzusammenbruch sucht sie auf Julias Drangen Hilfe in einer Klinik.Nun steht Julia vor der schweren Aufgabe, dem kranken, von der Chemotherapie gezeichneten Stefan ganz alleine beizustehen. Darunter leidet jedoch ihre berufliche Karriere. Schon bald wird Julia im Verlag vor die Wahl gestellt: Will sie weiterhin ihre Fuhrungsposition ausuben oder sich zunehmend ihrem privaten Umfeld widmen? Zum ersten Mal droht die selbstbewusste Julia die Kontrolle uber ihr Leben zu verlieren. Als sie wenig spater mit ihrer Schwester ins Reine kommt, zugleich ein wichtiges Fusionsgeschaft ihres Verlages rettet, und der kleine Stefan mit guten Prognosen aus dem Krankenhaus entlassen wird, scheint sich endlich alles zum Guten zu wenden. Aber gerade als Julia voller Selbstsicherheit mit ihren Vorstandschefs uber ihre weitere Karriere diskutiert, trifft die Nachricht ein, dass Stefans Zustand sich schlagartig verschlechtert hat.

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.sub-title: FuSSballprofi Benjamin Henrichs - Vom Verletzungsschock zum Comeback-Traum
programme.desc: Millions see this football evening shortly before Christmas 2024, as he collapses. Benjamin Henrichs, RB Leipzig-Profi and German international, lies on the lawn and cries. His Achilles tendon is torn. Just like that. After a bang as loud as a lash. Without an opponent having to go. At the end of the top game against Bavaria Munchen, which RB Leipzig loses high, Sanitter has to carry the 28-year-old floodlights. A light that Benjamin Henrich has known since the beginning of his steep career. Thousands of fans and followers praise Henrich's player to heaven when he conjures up the ball, or have it when a game goes wrong. This light is sophisticated, Benjamin Henrichs simply a person who suffers and has doubts. Can I play again at some point? Who am I without football? Who is really to me? A tear of the Achilles tendon is considered one of the worst injuries that an athlete can have. The healing process is complicated. Output uncertain. Benjamin Henrichs tries to at least gain control over part of his life. He begins to document his injury and the healing process in film. With the help of his sister Tabea, who has often stood in her brother's shadow, a very personal insight is created. "Faith Over Fear" calls you the documentary that is intended for his followers. In German: Faith overflows fear. It deals with his injury, his belief in God and his struggle, to be able to play again. Maybe in the new season. At the latest for the 2026 World Cup, he wants to stand on the pitch again. The last word of whether his comeback dream will go into fulfillment, neither he nor any coach, Benjamin Henrichs is certain. Questions about your own life, the meaning of the whole and about what really pays: people who are close to us who only see us. No matter what status we have. / Millionen sehen an diesem FuSSballabend kurz vor Weihnachten 2024, wie er zusammenbricht. Benjamin Henrichs, RB-Leipzig-Profi und deutscher Nationalspieler, liegt auf dem Rasen und weint. Seine Achillessehne ist gerissen. Einfach so. Nach einem Knall so laut wie ein Peitschenhieb. Ohne dass ihn ein Gegner beruhrt hat. Am Ende des Spitzenspiels gegen Bayern Munchen, das RB Leipzig haushoch verliert, mussen Sanitater den 28-Jahrigen aus dem gleiSSenden Flutlicht tragen.Ein Licht, das Benjamin Henrichs seit Beginn seiner steilen Karriere kennt. Tausende Fans und Follower loben den Spieler Henrichs in den Himmel, wenn er mit dem Ball zaubert, oder haten ihn, wenn ein Spiel danebengeht. Plotzlich ist dieses Licht aus, Benjamin Henrichs einfach ein Mensch, der leidet und Zweifel hat. Kann ich irgendwann wieder spielen? Wer bin ich ohne FuSSball? Wer halt wirklich zu mir?Ein Riss der Achillessehne gilt als eine der schlimmsten Verletzungen, die ein Sportler haben kann. Der Heilungsprozess ist kompliziert. Ausgang ungewiss. Benjamin Henrichs versucht, zumindest uber einen Teil seines Lebens die Kontrolle zu gewinnen. Er beginnt, sich, seine Verletzung und den Heilungsprozess filmisch zu dokumentieren. Mit Hilfe seiner Schwester Tabea, die oft im Schatten ihres Bruders gestanden hat, entsteht ein sehr personlicher Einblick."Faith over Fear" nennen sie die Dokumentation, die fur seine Follower bestimmt ist. Zu Deutsch: Glaube uberwindet Angst. Darin geht es um seine Verletzung, seinen Glauben an Gott und seinen Kampf, wieder spielen zu konnen. Vielleicht in der neuen Saison. Spatestens zur WM 2026 will er wieder auf dem Platz stehen. Das letzte Wort daruber, ob sein Comeback-Traum in Erfullung gehen wird, haben weder er noch irgendein Trainer, ist sich Benjamin Henrichs sicher.In der "Echtes-Leben"-Reportage spricht der glaubige Christ offen uber seinen Glauben und stellt sich inmitten seiner Krise groSSen Fragen, die uns alle angehen. Fragen nach dem eigenen Lebensweg, dem Sinn des Ganzen und nach dem, was wirklich zahlt: Menschen, die uns nahestehen, die nur uns sehen. Egal, welchen Status wir haben.

programme.title: Shut Up, Bitch!
programme.desc: Wie gerat ein junger Mensch in den Bann frauenfeindlicher Online-Ideologien? Die ARD-Dokumentation taucht tief ein in ein Netzwerk aus YouTubern, Influencern und TikTok-Kanalen, die mit aggressiver Mannlichkeitsrhetorik Millionen junger Manner erreichen. Der Film begleitet zwei junge Menschen, deren Leben und politische Einstellungen sich durch die Inhalte dieser Parallelwelt entscheidend verandert haben, und macht deutlich, mit welcher Dynamik diese Netzwerke agieren. Hinter deren Erfolg stehen nicht nur Algorithmen, die diese Inhalte nach vorne spulen, sondern auch wirtschaftliche Interessen und eine politische Strategie. Die Dokumentation zeigt, wie frauenfeindliche Narrative gezielt fur Wahlkampfe genutzt werden - und weshalb sie eine wachsende Gefahr fur die Gleichberechtigung und die Demokratie darstellen.

programme.title: Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: The private cleaning lady of district manager Girwidz Kerstin Wilm is intended to bring the police station to the fore for a press appointment. But just when she wants to update Huberts and Staller's Saustall, she succumbs a poisoning - through tea bags! The first trace takes the two police officers into a luxurious fruhstuck scafe. According to a reservation bureau, the dead cleaning lady had made an appointment there with a stranger. Surprisingly, the stranger turns out to be district manager Girwidz. In return, the cleaning lady had asked him for the cleaning campaign for a favor. Girwidz cannot say what it was about. The case is clear for Staller: here was jealousy in the game. Hubert has a different guess: Kerstin Wilm had private information about her customers about whom she always liked to gossip. She hadn't stopped even in front of Girwidz. So what if she had found something about one of her customers that she better not found out? For example, the lawyer's wife Lotte Sommer, who with her boyish gartner, not only stopped the hedges; Or her husband, notary Andreas Sommer, who is said to have received the chic house by the lake by inheritance. In addition, there were the iglhauts who had driven down the manor of their deceased large -stented and were disinherited in a common way; Or that uncanny puppet doctor who still lives with mom and restored broken porcelain dolls. Suddenly more questions arise: what about the ominos letter that cleaner Kerstin inherited from the late large -stente iglhaut? And why is Girwidz actively involved in the investigation? But even though Hubert excludes a relationship between Girwidz and Kerstin Wilm, it is a girwidz connection to his cleaning lady who leads to the solution of the case. / Die private Putzfrau von Revierleiter Girwidz Kerstin Wilm soll das Polizeirevier fur einen Pressetermin auf Vordermann bringen. Doch gerade, als sie Huberts und Stallers Saustall aufraumen will, erliegt sie einer Vergiftung - durch Teebeutel! Die erste Spur fuhrt die beiden Polizisten in ein luxurioses Fruhstuckscafe. Laut einer Reservierungsbestatigung hatte sich die tote Putzfrau dort mit einem Unbekannten zum Fruhstuck verabredet. Überraschenderweise entpuppt sich der Unbekannte als Revierleiter Girwidz. Die Putzfrau hatte ihn im Gegenzug fur die Putzaktion um einen Gefallen gebeten. Worum es dabei ging, kann Girwidz nicht sagen. Fur Staller ist der Fall klar: Hier war Eifersucht im Spiel. Hubert hat da eine andere Vermutung: Über ihre Kunden hatte Kerstin Wilm private Informationen, uber die sie immer gerne getratscht hat. Selbst vor Girwidz hatte sie nicht Halt gemacht. Was, wenn sie also uber einen ihrer Kunden etwas herausgefunden hatte, was sie besser nicht hatte herausfinden sollen? Da ware zum Beispiel die Anwaltsgattin Lotte Sommer, die mit ihrer burschikosen Gartnerin zusammen nicht nur die Hecken stutzte; oder ihr Mann, Notar Andreas Sommer, dem man nachsagt, das schicke Haus am See per Erbschleicherei bekommen zu haben. AuSSerdem waren da noch die Iglhauts, die den Gutshof ihrer verstorbenen GroSStante heruntergewirtschaftet haben und auf gemeine Art und Weise enterbt worden sind; oder eben jener unheimliche Puppendoktor, der noch immer bei der Mama lebt und bruchige Porzellanpuppen restauriert. Plotzlich tauchen noch mehr Fragen auf: Was hat es mit dem ominosen Brief auf sich, den Putzfrau Kerstin von der verstorbenen GroSStante Iglhaut geerbt hat? Und warum mischt sich Girwidz standig aktiv in die Ermittlungen ein? Aber obwohl Hubert ein Verhaltnis zwischen Girwidz und Kerstin Wilm ausschlieSSt, so ist es doch Girwidz Verbindung zu seiner Putzfrau, die zur Losung des Falles fuhrt.

programme.title: Seiji Ozawa - back in Japan / Seiji Ozawa - Zuruck in Japan
programme.desc: Born in 1935, Seiji Ozawa was an outstanding artist's personality until his death in February 2024 that never met the cliché of a "classic" musician. Ozawa learned from Leonard Bernstein and Herbert von Karajan and was the first Asian to head a large western orchestra: the renowned Boston Symphony Orchestra, at the top of which he was supposed to stand for almost 30 years. The Japanese conductor made the orchestra from Boston one of the most found ensembles of North America. After a serious illness, Seiji Ozawa, who was music director of the Vienna State Opera from 2002 to 2010, finally finally returned to Japan. There he was primarily concerned with the demand for young musicians, whom he wanted to convey his love for music. Director Olivier Simonnet accompanied Ozawa in Japan for almost two years. In the portrait, Seiji Ozawa speaks about Asia, the discovery of the western repertoire in Japan, large composers and of course about the transfer of his can. His split relationship to his home country also becomes clear: the musician, who was celebrated as a national hero, was earlier an outsider who tackled his claims and his love of freedom. / 1935 geboren, war Seiji Ozawa bis zu seinem Tod im Februar 2024 eine herausragende Kunstlerpersonlichkeit, die nie dem Klischee eines "klassischen" Musikers entsprach. Ozawa lernte bei Leonard Bernstein und Herbert von Karajan und leitete als erster Asiate ein groSSes westliches Orchester: das renommierte Boston Symphony Orchestra, an dessen Spitze er nahezu 30 Jahre lang stehen sollte. Der japanische Dirigent machte das Orchester aus Boston zu einem der beruhmtesten Ensembles Nordamerikas.Nach einer schweren Erkrankung kehrte Seiji Ozawa, der von 2002 bis 2010 Musikdirektor der Wiener Staatsoper war, schlieSSlich endgultig nach Japan zuruck. Dort bemuhte er sich vor allem um die Forderung von jungen Nachwuchsmusikern, denen er seine Liebe zur Musik vermitteln wollte.Regisseur Olivier Simonnet begleitete Ozawa fast zwei Jahre lang in Japan. In dem Portrait spricht Seiji Ozawa uber Asien, die Entdeckung des westlichen Repertoires in Japan, groSSe Komponisten und naturlich uber die Weitergabe seines Konnens. Dabei wird auch sein gespaltenes Verhaltnis zu seinem Heimatland deutlich: Der Musiker, der als Nationalheld gefeiert wurde, war fruher ein Outsider, der mit seinen Anspruchen und seiner Freiheitsliebe aneckte.

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Agriculture in change. Does the future of genetic engineering belong? / Landwirtschaft im Wandel. Gehort die Zukunft der Gentechnik?
programme.desc: The use of genetic engineering in agriculture is still controversial after almost 30 years. In addition to environmental concerns and the monopoly position of some fewer seed manufacturers, critics drove the long-term consequences to be tapped. In Europe, many consumers vehemently reject "genetic engineering on the plate". The cultivation of genetically connected plants has been cut in the EU, and in Austria they still have not come to the fields. The large agricultural -producing countries such as the USA, Canada, Brazil or India, on the other hand, rely flatly on it: worldwide generous plants are grown on around 200 million hectares of hectares. Minged into the genome, which means that plants become more resistant to climate extremes and males more resistance and their cultivation is less stressful. For some young farmers it is clear: in the future, agriculture does not have to contradict nature. After a few Durresommern, they were used more resistant NGT corn. But there is worry that in addition to the dependency on seed companies NGT seeds at the end of the day will be too expensive for small farmers. USA correspondent Thomas Langpaul is on local inspection in Oklahoma. The state in the country's central Suden pays to the fuided wheat producers and is one of the hotspots of the American agricultural industry. In addition to wheat, corn, soy and cotton is grown on the huge farms that still rely on classic genetic engineering (GMO). But here too, a rethink begins, because the consequences of climate change - such as extreme dur periods, soil erosion and thus falling streak - also present the large companies with enormous challenges. In 2021, the government dares an experiment: the entire country is to be switched to biological agriculture. Instead of a gradual transition, import and use of synthetic dung agents and pesticides are banned almost over night. Within a few months, the harvesting carrier breaks down drastically, the food prices shoot into the high, protests shocks the country. Correspondent Benedict Feichtner meets peasant families who have lost their livelihood as a result of the abrupt change. In the meantime, imported seeds and chemical sprays have been approved again, but at the same time a kind of countermovement has arisen: in training centers, small farmers learn today how they can sustainably operate organic farming using traditional and regenerative methods and thus escape the dependency on the large seed corporations. / Der Einsatz von Gentechnik in der Landwirtschaft ist - nach inzwischen fast 30 Jahren - immer noch umstritten. Kritiker fuhren neben Umweltbedenken und der Monopolstellung einiger weniger Saatgut-Hersteller vor allem die schwer abzuschatzenden Langzeitfolgen ins Treffen. In Europa lehnen viele Verbraucher "Gentechnik am Teller" vehement ab. Der Anbau gentechnisch veranderter Pflanzen ist in der EU stark eingeschrankt, in Österreich kommen sie bis heute nicht auf die Felder. Die groSSen agrarproduzierenden Lander wie die USA, Kanada, Brasilien oder auch Indien setzen hingegen flachendeckend darauf: weltweit werden auf rund 200 Millionen Hektar genmodifizierte Pflanzen angebaut.In Belgien spricht Korrespondent Johannes Perterer mit Wissenschaftlerinnen, die NGT - also die "Neue Gentechnik" - als groSSe Chance sehen: mit Entwicklungen wie der sogenannten "Genschere" sind prazisere Eingriffe ins Erbgut moglich, wodurch Pflanzen kunftig widerstandsfahiger gegen Klimaextreme und Schadlinge werden und ihr Anbau die Boden weniger belastet. Fur einige junge Bauern steht fest: in Zukunft muss Landwirtschaft nicht im Widerspruch zur Natur stehen. Nach einigen Durresommern wurden sie resistenteren NGT-Mais einsetzen. Doch es bleibt die Sorge, dass neben der Abhangigkeit von Saatgutkonzernen NGT-Saatgut am Ende des Tages fur kleine Bauern zu teuer sein wird.USA-Korrespondent Thomas Langpaul ist auf Lokalaugenschein in Oklahoma unterwegs. Der Bundesstaat im zentralen Suden des Landes zahlt zu den fuhrenden Weizenproduzenten und ist einer der Hotspots der amerikanischen Agrarindustrie. Auf den riesigen Farmen, die nach wie vor auf die klassische Gentechnik (GMO) setzen, wird neben Weizen vor allem Mais, Soja und Baumwolle angebaut. Doch auch hier beginnt ein Umdenken, denn die Folgen des Klimawandels - wie extreme Durreperioden, Bodenerosion und damit sinkende Ertrage - stellen auch die GroSSbetriebe vor enorme Herausforderungen.In Sri Lanka wagt die Regierung 2021 ein Experiment: das gesamte Land soll auf biologische Landwirtschaft umgestellt werden. Anstatt eines schrittweisen Überganges werden Einfuhr und Verwendung synthetischer Dungemittel und Pestizide quasi uber Nacht verboten. Binnen weniger Monate brechen die Ernteertrage drastisch ein, die Lebensmittelpreise schieSSen in die Hohe, Proteste erschuttern das Land. Korrespondent Benedict Feichtner trifft Bauernfamilien, die als Folge des abrupten Umstiegs ihre Existenzgrundlage verloren haben. Inzwischen sind importiertes Saatgut und chemische Spritzmittel wieder zugelassen, doch gleichzeitig ist eine Art Gegenbewegung entstanden: in Schulungszentren lernen Kleinbauern heute, wie sie mit traditionellen und regenerativen Methoden Bio-Landwirtschaft nachhaltig betreiben und so aus der Abhangigkeit von den groSSen Saatgut-Konzernen entkommen konnen.

programme.title: Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers
programme.sub-title: From the Puszta to the Adriatic / Von der Puszta an die Adria
programme.desc: The five of the successful series "On the rails of the double -headed eagle" by Bjorn Kolz and Gernot Stadler takes the viewer on a cinematic journey into the Hungarian imperial monster of the former Danube monarchy.*The Hungarian lanes with their train station, bridges and viaducts are both architecturally and cultural -historically. They achieved their importance as a connection between the Eastern and Western European economic areas with the Balkans.*Once there was a country, from whose sky sun, crescent moon and Davidstern, a realm, as far as the flight of the Habsburg dual eagle. What remained have remained memories of a time that has been forgiven for their mistakes and which is called the "good old". And they are rail streets that have remained. Iron Bander, laid on thousands of kilometers between swamps and gorges, steppe and sea. They once kept together an empire in the heart of Europe: Austria-Hungary. The starting point of the cinematic journey is Budapest with its elaborated Bahnhofen, the Keleti and the Nyugati train station, two magnificent cathedrals of the railway age. Georg Habsburg runs through Budapest, where his grandfather Karl was crowned for the last king of Hungary and accompanies us to Godollo, the favorite castle of Konigin Elisabeth. A visit to the largest railway museum in Europe, the Budapest locomotive park, as little as a ride with a historic steam train on the oldest railway line in Hungary. The same as the railway network in the Hungarian empire wasted from Budapest from a star form, and also follows the old train lines according to Temesvar in today's Rumania, to "Banmering" With its numerous browns and tunnels, to the forest railways in Sudwesten in Hungary or to Croatia, where the so -called "Hungarian Riviera" attracted numerous nobles, artists and burger year for year. The port city of Fiume, today's Rijeka, competed with the Easter Reiche harbor and still testify to many buildings in the old town or the old shipyards from the former glory of Rijeka at the time of the Habsburg. "On the rails of the double eagle - from the Puszta to the Adriatic" is a cinematic journey through the times and to be removed from the former. Austria-Hungary, which was held together not least by his more than 46,000 kilometer railway network until his demise. / Der funfte Teil der Erfolgsserie "Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers" von Bjorn Kolz und Gernot Stadler nimmt den Zuseher mit auf eine filmische Reise in die ungarische Reichshalfte der ehemaligen Donaumonarchie.*Die ungarischen Bahnen mit ihren Bahnhofen, Brucken und Viadukten gelten sowohl architektonisch als auch kulturgeschichtlich als Leistung ersten Ranges. Ihre Bedeutung erlangten sie als Verbindung zwischen den ost- und westeuropaischen Wirtschaftsraumen mit dem Balkan.*Es war einmal ein Land, von dessen Himmel Sonne, Halbmond und Davidstern friedlich vereint herabfunkelten, ein Reich, so weit wie die Flugelspannen des habsburgischen Doppeladlers. Geblieben sind Erinnerungen an eine Zeit, der man ihre Fehler langst verziehen hat und die man die "gute alte" nennt. Und es sind Schienenstrange, die geblieben sind. Eiserne Bander, verlegt auf tausenden Kilometern zwischen Sumpfen und Schluchten, Steppe und Meer. Einst hielten sie ein Reich im Herzen Europas zusammen: Österreich-Ungarn.Ausgangspunkt der filmischen Reise ist Budapest mit seinen beruhmten Bahnhofen, dem Keleti und dem Nyugati-Bahnhof, zwei prachtvollen Kathedralen des Eisenbahnzeitalters. Georg Habsburg fuhrt durch Budapest, wo sein GroSSvater Karl zum letzten Konig von Ungarn gekront wurde und begleitet uns nach Godollo, dem Lieblingsschloss von Konigin Elisabeth. Ein Besuch im groSSten Eisenbahnmuseum Europas, dem Lokpark von Budapest fehlt ebenso wenig, wie eine Fahrt mit einem historischen Dampfzug auf der altesten Bahnlinie Ungarns.So wie sich das Eisenbahnnetz in der ungarischen Reichshalfte von Budapest aus sternformig verzweigte und in alle Himmelrichtungen fuhrte, folgt auch die Dokumentation den alten Bahnlinien nach Temesvar im heutigen Rumanien, zum "Banater Semmering" mit seinen zahlreichen Brucken und Tunnels, zu den Waldbahnen im Sudwesten Ungarns oder nach Kroatien, wo die sogenannte "ungarische Riviera" Jahr fur Jahr zahlreiche Adelige, Kunstler und Burger anlockte. Die Hafenstadt Fiume, das heutige Rijeka, machte dem osterreichischen Hafen Triest Konkurrenz und auch jetzt noch zeugen viele Gebaude in der Altstadt oder die alten Werftanlagen vom einstigen Glanz Rijekas zur Zeit der Habsburger."Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers - Von der Puszta an die Adria" ist eine filmische Reise durch die Zeiten und zu entlegenen Winkeln des einstigen Vielvolkerstaates Österreich-Ungarn, der bis zu seinem Untergang nicht zuletzt von seinem mehr als 46.000 Kilometer langen Eisenbahnnetz zusammengehalten wurde.Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler und Bjorn Kolz
