Die Menschen leiden unter Terror, Klimawandel, Hunger und Perspektivlosigkeit. Mehr als die Halfte aller Terroropfer weltweit stammen inzwischen von hier. Russland bietet den neuen Regimen Ruckendeckung und verfolgt dabei knallharte strategische Interessen.Diese Dokumentation fuhrt in Lander, in denen Journalismus kaum noch moglich ist. Unter lebensgefahrlichen Bedingungen ist es dem Filmteam gelungen, exklusive Einblicke zu gewinnen in eine Welt der Einschuchterung, der Repression und des geopolitischen Wettlaufs.

programme.title: Geheime Weltmachte - Kampf um die Handelsrouten
programme.desc: Good transport is the lifeline of global world trade. A global, dominated network dominated by large players guarantees the smooth exchange between the continents. The transport systems are increasingly reaching their limits: overloaded streets, large container ships and the air freight have an even worse ecological balance as a truck and ships. What about the goods traffic? And what has to be done to make it future -oriented? How important freight traffic is for modern life was suddenly demonstrated during the corona crisis, as modern production chains and the associated just-in-time production through locations. It was suddenly realized that it is by no means secure to bring vital medication, ventilation device, vaccines or protective masks to where they are needed. The transport volume of the industry collapsed by six percent this year. Local providers jumped in this crisis that were not slowed down by international travel barriers. Companies such as Astral Aviation from Kenya became a guarantee for survival in decentralized regions. They took the chance that offered themselves and gave the big competitors in the hard -hugging air freight joke. The freight industry works most profitably when they were bundle at certain locations and then laid out the main path with large, possible fully utilized means of transport. This path runs in around 90 percent of all cases over the oceans of the earth. That is why industry giants such as Cosco, Kuehne+Nagel or Maersk have built more and more large container ships in the past decades. As a result, these giants of the world's oceans can start with fewer and fewer ports, form long traffic jams in front of these specially developed, expensive port, which then cause horrendous fuel costs. Amazon has recently been reacting to this development by relying on smaller ships that can be handled faster in more expensive ports. And Amazon also shows inconspicuous business on the country path. The most expensive section in the supply chain is the so -called last mile to the end customer. In metropolises, where Amazon can save costs by delivering its packages itself, the trade giant has been able to do exactly that. On the other hand, there are no advantages in remote areas, the transport is happy to be transported to the competition. Anniaced freight forwarders drive with their trucks over the continents of this earth and ensure people's care. And they use the streets and cause traffic jams. The street problem is shown, for example, on Canada's Highway 401, where a relief street against the protest of environmental users is to be built, although there is already an alternative - private and therefore liable to toll. Or based on the motorway system in Italy, which is mainly in private hands. Trimmed for great efficiency, security is often on the track - with some fatal consequences, such as in 2018 when the Morandi Bringe collapsed in Genoa. Food printing, low margins, previously unbelievable environmental issues, high personnel costs and investments: The transport industry is in transition. Central question: Who will find the technical solutions of the future first, and who will stay on the route in this race? In the four -part series "Secret World Machines", the filmmakers get to the bottom of the question of who determines the future of the globalized markets in important areas of life. / Der Gutertransport ist die Lebensader des globalen Welthandels. Ein weltumspannendes, von groSSen Playern dominiertes Netz garantiert den reibungslosen Austausch zwischen den Kontinenten.Die Transportsysteme geraten zunehmend an ihre Grenzen: Überlastete StraSSen, zu groSSe Containerschiffe und die Luftfracht haben eine noch schlechtere Ökobilanz als Lkw und Schiffe. Wie steht es um den Warenverkehr? Und was muss geschehen, damit er zukunftsfahig wird?Die globalisierte Wirtschaft lebt davon, dass Guter innerhalb kurzer Zeit in jeden Winkel der Erde transportiert werden konnen. Wie wichtig der Frachtverkehr fur das moderne Leben ist, zeigte sich schlagartig wahrend der Coronakrise, als moderne Produktionsketten und die damit einhergehende Just-in-time-Fertigung durch gestorte Warenstrome zusammenbrachen. Plotzlich wurde klar, dass es keineswegs gesichert ist, lebenswichtige Medikamente, Beatmungsgerate, Impfstoffe oder Schutzmasken rechtzeitig dorthin zu bringen, wo sie gebraucht werden.Die Flugzeuge von Marktfuhrer FedEx und anderen Schwergewichten wie DHL oder UPS blieben im Fruhjahr 2020 am Boden. Das Transportvolumen der Branche brach in diesem Jahr um sechs Prozent ein. In dieser Krise sprangen lokale Anbieter ein, die nicht durch internationale Reisebeschrankungen ausgebremst wurden. Unternehmen wie Astral Aviation aus Kenia wurden zum Garanten furs Überleben in dezentralen Regionen. Sie ergriffen die Chance, die sich bot, und luchsten den groSSen Konkurrenten im hart umkampften Luftfrachtgeschaft Marktanteile ab.Die Frachtbranche arbeitet am profitabelsten, wenn sie Waren an bestimmten Orten bundelt und dann den Hauptweg mit groSSen, moglichst voll ausgelasteten Transportmitteln zurucklegt. Dieser Weg fuhrt in rund 90 Prozent aller Falle uber die Ozeane dieser Erde. Deshalb haben Branchenriesen wie COSCO, Kuehne+Nagel oder Maersk in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten immer groSSere Containerschiffe gebaut. Das hat zur Folge, dass diese Giganten der Weltmeere immer weniger Hafen anlaufen konnen, sich vor diesen extra ausgebauten, teuren Hafen lange Staus bilden, die dann horrende Treibstoffkosten verursachen. Amazon reagiert seit Neuestem auf diese Entwicklung, indem das Unternehmen auf kleinere Schiffe setzt, die in gunstigeren Hafen schneller abgefertigt werden konnen.Und auch auf dem Landweg zeigt Amazon untruglichen Geschaftssinn. Der teuerste Abschnitt in der Lieferkette ist die sogenannte letzte Meile zum Endkunden. In Metropolen, wo Amazon Kosten einsparen kann, indem das Unternehmen seine Pakete selbst ausliefert, ist der Handelsriese dazu ubergegangen, genau das zu tun. Zeichnen sich in abgelegenen Gegenden dagegen keine Vorteile ab, uberlasst man den Transport gerne der Konkurrenz.Die StraSSe selbst ist einer der am hartesten umkampften Transportwege. Unzahlige Spediteure fahren mit ihren Lkw uber die Kontinente dieser Erde und sichern die Versorgung der Menschen. Und sie nutzen die StraSSen ab und verursachen Staus. Das StraSSenproblem zeigt sich zum Beispiel an Kanadas Highway 401, wo eine EntlastungsstraSSe gegen den Protest von Umweltschutzern gebaut werden soll, obwohl es bereits eine - private und daher mautpflichtige - Alternative gibt. Oder anhand des Autobahnsystems in Italien, das uberwiegend in privater Hand liegt. Auf groSStmogliche Effizienz getrimmt, bleibt dabei haufig die Sicherheit auf der Strecke - mit teilweise fatalen Folgen, wie zum Beispiel 2018 beim Einsturz der Morandi-Brucke in Genua.Kostendruck, geringe Margen, bislang ungeloste Umweltfragen, hohe Personalkosten und Investitionen: Die Transportbranche ist im Umbruch. Zentrale Frage dabei: Wer findet zuerst die technischen Losungen der Zukunft, und wer bleibt bei diesem Wettlauf auf der Strecke?In der vierteiligen Reihe "Geheime Weltmachte" gehen die Filmemacher der Frage auf den Grund, wer in wichtigen Lebensbereichen uber die Zukunft der globalisierten Markte bestimmt.

programme.title: No compass K2 E10 (E) / Χωρίς Πυξίδα Κ2 Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kasos. Penelope and Yiannis reach the southernmost island of the Dodecanese, famous for its picturesque settlements, its virgin beaches, local festivals, music, as well as its delicious, traditional cuisine. / Επεισόδιο: Κάσος. Η Πηνελόπη και ο Γιάννης φτάνουν στο νοτιότερο νησί των Δωδεκανήσων που φημίζεται για τους γραφικούς οικισμούς της, τις παρθένες παραλίες της, τα τοπικά πανηγύρια, τις μουσικές της, καθώς και για τη νόστιμη, παραδοσιακή κουζίνα της.

programme.title: Jacket to get K2 E10 (E) / Ζακέτα να Πάρεις Κ2 Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Who is right in the end. A Damage to Despina's water heater again brings to the center of interest in the secret life of Efthimi, when the electrician recognizes him from a dating application! Fouli finally feels justified. / Επεισόδιο: Ποια έχει δίκιο τελικά. Μια βλάβη στο θερμοσίφωνο της Δέσποινας φέρνει πάλι στο επίκεντρο του ενδιαφέροντος την κρυφή ζωή του Ευθύμη, όταν ο ηλεκτρολόγος τον αναγνωρίζει από μία εφαρμογή γνωριμιών! Η Φούλη νιώθει επιτέλους δικαιωμένη.

programme.title: Jacket to get K2 E11 (E) / Ζακέτα να Πάρεις Κ2 Ε11 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Revelation now. Fouli has decided not to continue the song in the end, with Aristea and Despina to tell her fortunately, because she escaped Eugenia last year. But Eugenia accidentally discovers a photo of her. / Επεισόδιο: Αποκάλυψη τώρα. Η Φούλη έχει αποφασίσει να μη συνεχίσει το τραγούδι τελικά, με την Αριστέα και τη Δέσποινα να της λένε ευτυχώς, γιατί στο παρά πέντε γλίτωσε πέρσι από το να την ανακαλύψει η Ευγενία. Όμως η Ευγενία ανακαλύπτει τυχαία μια φωτογραφία της.

programme.title: To foreign hands E1 (e) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Charalambos Fegoudis, owner of the Snacks company, is called upon to face the most critical moment of his business and personal life. / Ο Χαράλαμπος Φεγκούδης, ιδιοκτήτης της ομώνυμης εταιρείας snacks, καλείται να αντιμετωπίσει την κρισιμότερη στιγμή της επιχειρηματικής και προσωπικής του ζωής.

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The History of Greek Radio. The show presents the history of Greek radio. The first steps took place in the mid -20s, but the official launch came during the dictator Metaxas, with a strong propaganda character. / Επεισόδιο: Η ιστορία της Ελληνικής Ραδιοφωνίας. Η εκπομπή παρουσιάζει την ιστορία της ελληνικής ραδιοφωνίας. Τα πρώτα βήματα έγιναν στα μέσα της δεκαετίας του 20, αλλά η επίσημη έναρξη ήρθε στα χρόνια του δικτάτορα Μεταξά, με έντονο προπαγανδιστικό χαρακτήρα.

programme.title: We arrived! K3 E37 (E) / Φτάσαμε! Κ3 Ε37 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Meganisi. A paradise with virgin beaches, traditional villages and magnificent sea caves between Lefkada and Aitoloakarnania explores the show We arrived with Jerome Kalouta. / Επεισόδιο: Μεγανήσι. Έναν Παράδεισο με παρθένες παραλίες, παραδοσιακά χωριά και μαγευτικές θαλάσσιες σπηλιές ανάμεσα στη Λευκάδα και την Αιτωλοακαρνανία εξερευνά η εκπομπή Φτάσαμε με τον Ζερόμ Καλούτα.

programme.title: Morning / Πρωίαν Σε Είδον
programme.desc: PREMIERE. The favorite morning magazine returns for the fourth year and for three hours daily, Fotis Sergoulopoulos and Jenny Melita welcome us with their familiar smile in a show that stands out. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Το αγαπημένο πρωινό μαγκαζίνο επιστρέφει για τέταρτη χρονιά και για τρεις ώρες καθημερινά, ο Φώτης Σεργουλόπουλος και η Τζένη Μελιτά μάς υποδέχονται με το γνώριμο χαμόγελό τους, σε μια εκπομπή που ξεχωρίζει.

programme.title: News - Sports - Weather / Ειδήσεις - Αθλητικά - Καιρός

programme.title: Life otherwise K4 (e) / Η Ζωή Αλλιώς Κ4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Lesvos, Archontonisi. In this episode, on our way people were found strong, conscious, and women of real nobles. But also sounds of santuri, bird flies and flower nuts and fresh coffee. / Επεισόδιο: Λέσβος, το Αρχοντονήσι. Σε αυτό το επεισόδιο, στο δρόμο μας βρέθηκαν άνθρωποι δυνατοί, συνειδητοποιημένοι, και γυναίκες πραγματικές αρχόντισσες. Αλλά και ήχοι από σαντούρι, πετάγματα πουλιών και μοσχοβολιές λουλουδιών και φρέσκου καφέ.

programme.title: Pop cooking K9 / ΠΟΠ Μαγειρική Κ9
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Pygmalion Dadakaridis. At the premiere of the new season, Andreas Lagos and the beloved guest cook together a delicious dish of Kalavryta noodles and a sweet, full of aromas, honey from Halki. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Πυγμαλίων Δαδακαρίδης. Στην πρεμιέρα της νέας σεζόν, ο Ανδρέας Λαγός και ο αγαπημένος καλεσμένος μαγειρεύουν μαζί ένα απολαυστικό πιάτο με χυλοπίτες Καλαβρύτων και ένα γλυκό, γεμάτο αρώματα, με μέλι από τη Χάλκη.

programme.title: Studio 4 / Στούντιο 4
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Nancy Zambetoglou and Thanassis Anagnostopoulos are returning for the fifth year to talk about everything that concerns us, inspire, entertain us or move us. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. programme.title: Central News Bulletin - Sports - Weather / Κεντρικό Δελτίο Ειδήσεων - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: With correspondents in every corner of Greece and around the world, the ERT Central News Bulletin brings to every home everyday reporting, extraordinary news, and what affects our lives. / Με ανταποκριτές σε κάθε γωνιά της Ελλάδας και σε όλο τον κόσμο το κεντρικό δελτίο ειδήσεων της ΕΡΤ μεταφέρει σε κάθε σπίτι το καθημερινό ρεπορτάζ, τις έκτακτες ειδήσεις, αλλά και όσα επηρεάζουν τη ζωή μας.

programme.title: The adventures of Hercules Poirot K11 E1 (E) / Οι Περιπέτειες του Ηρακλή Πουαρό Κ11 Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Stigma on the face. A man, James Bendley, is condemned to the murder of a woman who was found dead in her home in the little village of Brunchini. Inspector SPENS doubts Bedley's guilt and Hercules Poirot is called upon to further investigate the case. / Επεισόδιο: Στίγμα στο Πρόσωπο. Ένας άνδρας, ο Τζέιμς Μπέντλεϊ, καταδικάζεται για το φόνο μίας γυναίκας που βρέθηκε νεκρή στο σπίτι της, στο μικρό χωριουδάκι Μπρόουντχινι. Ο Επιθεωρητής Σπενς αμφιβάλλει για την ενοχή του Μπέντλεϊ και ο Ηρακλής Πουαρό καλείται να ερευνήσει περαιτέρω την υπόθεση.

programme.title: Pre Game (G) / Pre Game (Ζ)
programme.desc: Men's Eurobasket 2025. programme.title: Basketball: Serbia - Czech Republic (G) / Μπάσκετ: Σερβία - Τσεχία (Ζ)
programme.desc: Men's Eurobasket 2025. Group C - 4th race. Watch the 2025 Eurobasket Games hosted by Cyprus, Latvia, Poland and Finland. / Ευρωμπάσκετ Ανδρών 2025. Γ Όμιλος - 4η Αγωνιστική. programme.title: Love from the beginning / Έρωτας από την Αρχή
programme.desc: After a serious car accident, a married woman wakes up from the coma, without being able to remember the last years of her life. Now, her husband should regain the heart of his beloved ... (99) / Έπειτα από ένα σοβαρό αυτοκινητιστικό ατύχημα, μια παντρεμένη γυναίκα ξυπνά από το κώμα, χωρίς να μπορεί να θυμηθεί τα τελευταία χρόνια της ζωής της. programme.title: Volleyball: World Women's Volleyball Championship (G) / Βόλεϊ: Παγκόσμιο Πρωτάθλημα Βόλεϊ Γυναικών (Ζ)

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Outside Map of K3 E2 (E) / Γκόρντον Ράμσεϊ: Εκτός Χάρτη Κ3 Ε2 (Ε)

programme.title: On the Road Ε9 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Asterousia Mountains, Environmental Information, Climbing. programme.title: The music of the world (e) / Οι Μουσικές του Κόσμου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Brazil, Part B. programme.desc: Haunted by his mysterious past, a high school football coach leads a liposel team of orphan to the state championship during the Great Depression and inspires a dissolved nation. Αυτοί οι εγκληματίες δεν επιδιώκουν μόνο το χρήμα, αλλά και την εξουσία.

programme.title: The Aegean of our life E2 (e) / Το Αιγαίο της Ζωής μας Ε2 (Ε)

Η ΕΡΤ3 καταγράφει την πορεία και το έργο των 130 εθελοντών της Ομάδας Αιγαίου, που διασχίζουν τα κύματα για να δώσουν ουσιαστική φροντίδα και ελπίδα στους κατοίκους των ακριτικών νησιών μέσα από ιατρικές, ενημερωτικές, κατασκευαστικές, εκπαιδευτικές και πολιτιστικές δράσεις.

Μέσα από διηγήσεις ανθρώπων, τίθενται τα ερωτήματα που καλούνται στη συνέχεια να απαντήσουν οι ειδικοί.

programme.title: Gothic Art: Terror and Faith (E) / Γοτθική Τέχνη: Τρόμος και Πίστη (Ε)
programme.desc: Death and devil, seduction and eroticism - almost six centuries ago, Gothic art fascinated people. In the poor in Middle Ages, this art was skillfully playing with the feelings of the viewer, causing fear and ecstasy. / Θάνατος και διάβολος, αποπλάνηση και ερωτισμός - πριν από σχεδόν έξι αιώνες, η γοτθική τέχνη γοήτευσε τους ανθρώπους. Στον φτωχό σε εικόνες Μεσαίωνα, αυτή η τέχνη έπαιζε επιδέξια με τα συναισθήματα του θεατή, προκαλώντας φόβο και έκσταση.

programme.title: Struggle / Αγώνας Επιβίωσης
programme.desc: During World War II, a Jewish boxer survives in the concentration camps, participating in boxing matches. Μα όταν καταφέρνει να φτάσει στην Αμερική, πασχίζει να συμφιλιωθεί με το τραυματικό παρελθόν του. (120)

Αλλά σε άλλες περιοχές του πλανήτη η τύχη είναι ανάμεικτη μέχρις εσχάτων. Όπου κι αν βρίσκεστε στον κόσμο, ένα είναι σίγουρο: ο Αύγουστος είναι ένας μήνας ενθουσιασμού.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Mallorca - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 3
programme.desc: Real Madrid have dropped points in two of their last five LaLiga games against Mallorca, having won nine of their previous 10 against the Balearic team in the competition. At home, Real Madrid have won each of their last nine LaLiga games against Mallorca, scoring an average of three goals per game, since a 1-3 defeat in May 2009 under Juande Ramos and Gregorio Manzano as Mallorca boss. This is their longest winning streak at home against them in the top-flight.

programme.desc: Monaco have won just one of their last five Ligue 1 matches against Le Havre, having won 10 of the previous 12. Monaco have only been defeated in their first game of a Ligue 1 season once in the last ten campaigns, winning the most recent three. Moreover, ASMs next success in L1 will be their 1100th, making Monaco the second club to reach this milestone after Marseille.

programme.title: Argentina vs Brazil - Final - 2025 FIBA AmeriCup
programme.desc: South America’s classic rivalry decides the AmeriCup. Argentina are the reigning champions with three titles (2001, 2011, 2022), while Brazil are four-time winners (1984, 1988, 2005, 2009). Argentina lead the senior head-to-head 25–17. Their last AmeriCup meeting was the 2022 final in Recife, which Argentina won 75–73; at the 2019 World Cup second round, Argentina won 87–73. Current FIBA Men’s World Ranking: Argentina No. 8, Brazil No. 12. Expect a tactical game where turnover margin, second-chance points, and late free throws decide it.

programme.title: Flyweight Muay Thai Fight Nong-O vs Kongthoranee
programme.desc: Muay Thai legends collide as former world champion Nong-O takes on rising star Kongthoranee in a highly anticipated flyweight main event. Experience fast-paced exchanges, technical mastery, and all the high-stakes drama as both fighters battle for supremacy under the iconic lights of Lumpinee Stadium. This gripping showdown promises edge-of-your-seat action and unforgettable moments for fight fans everywhere.

programme.title: Espanyol vs Osasuna - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 3
programme.desc: Espanyol have not won any of their last eight LaLiga games against Osasuna, since a 3-0 win in February 2017; their longest winless run against the Navarrese side in the competition. Osasuna have collected points in seven of their last eight LaLiga away games against Espanyol, after losing each of their previous three – the only exception in this run being a 0-3 defeat in February 2017.

programme.title: Wolverhampton Wanderers vs Everton - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3
programme.desc: Wolves have lost just two of their 11 Premier League home games against Everton, going down 3-0 in April 2011 and 2-1 in January 2021. Having been winless in six Premier League meetings with Wolves between the 2021-22 and 2023-24 campaigns, Everton remained unbeaten in both matches last term.

programme.title: Real Oviedo vs Real Sociedad - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 3
programme.desc: Real Oviedo have won two of their last five LaLiga matches against Real Sociedad, both at home, after failing to record a win in their previous seven top-flight clashes. Real Sociedad have won two of their last four LaLiga away matches against Real Oviedo, the same number of victories as they have in all their previous visits to the Asturian stadium in the history of the competition.

programme.title: Canada vs USA - 3rd Place - 2025 FIBA AmeriCup
programme.desc: Bronze is on the line after a quick turnaround. The USA are record AmeriCup winners with seven titles, while Canada are chasing a statement podium. The senior series favors the USA 21–2, although the most recent major clash flipped the script: Canada beat the USA 127–118 after overtime for 2023 World Cup bronze in Manila. Their last AmeriCup meeting was the 2022 bronze game, which the USA won 84–80. Current FIBA Men’s World Ranking: USA No. 1, Canada No. 6. Bench depth, defensive rebounding, and three-point efficiency are likely to separate them.

programme.title: Qualifying - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The qualifying session at Zandvoort will set the tone for the weekend, with the fight for pole between Doriane Pin, Chloe Chambers, and Marta García expected to be intense. The circuit’s narrow layout and fast, sweeping turns leave little margin for error, putting a premium on precision and car control. With grid position often decisive at this track, pole could be the difference between victory and defeat in both races of Round 5.

programme.title: Race 1 - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The opening 17-lap sprint of Round 5 is set to be a high-pressure contest where starts and first-corner battles may decide the order. Doriane Pin looks to extend her lead in the standings, but Chloe Chambers and Marta García are poised to strike. Tire management and avoiding track-limit penalties will be key on the demanding Zandvoort layout. The result will shape momentum heading into Sunday’s second sprint.

programme.title: Race 2 - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The second sprint race closes out the Zandvoort weekend with another 17-lap duel. With double opportunities for points across the two races, championship leader Doriane Pin must balance aggression with caution, while her rivals see this as the chance to narrow the gap. Zandvoort’s technical corners and high-risk overtaking zones raise the stakes, ensuring the round ends with tension and championship drama.

programme.title: Main Race - FIA Formula 1 World Championship - Dutch GP - 2025
programme.desc: The 15th race of the season unfolds at Zandvoort, with McLaren dominating the standings: Piastri (284 pts), Norris (275), Verstappen (187). McLaren lead constructors by a landslide. Narrow streets and high-speed corners mean strategy and qualifying are key. Expect fireworks in this clutch championship battle.

A Special Interview with Three Arab Tennis Stars
programme.desc: An exclusive joint interview featuring three rising Arab tennis talents — Hady Habib (Lebanon), Abdullah Shelbayh (Jordan), and Aziz Dougaz (Tunisia) — as they share their stories, ambitions, and experiences during their participation in the ATP 500 Qatar ExxonMobil Open 2025. In this candid conversation, the players reflect on their personal journeys, the challenges of representing their countries on the global stage, and their hopes for the future of Arab tennis.

programme.title: Toulouse vs PSG - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Toulouse have not won any of their last five home games against Paris SG in Ligue 1 and could equal their longest winless streak at home against PSG. Toulouse have won only two of their last 14 Ligue 1 home games against the defending champions, after winning the two previous.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Mallorca - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 3 - - Mini Match
programme.desc: Real Madrid have dropped points in two of their last five LaLiga games against Mallorca, having won nine of their previous 10 against the Balearic team in the competition. At home, Real Madrid have won each of their last nine LaLiga games against Mallorca, scoring an average of three goals per game, since a 1-3 defeat in May 2009 under Juande Ramos and Gregorio Manzano as Mallorca boss. This is their longest winning streak at home against them in the top-flight.

programme.title: Brighton and Hove Albion vs Manchester City - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Between 2017-18 and 2023-24, Brighton and Hove Albion only avoided defeat in two of 14 Premier League games against Man City ; last season, they didn’t lose against City, winning 2-1 at home and drawing 2-2 at the Etihad. Manchester City have won 19 out of 30 league matches against Brighton – among the 46 teams they’ve faced 25+ times, the only side they have a higher win ratio against is Swansea City.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Arsenal - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Liverpool are winless in six Premier League matches against Arsenal, their longest winless run against the Gunners since going eight without a win between October 2007 and April 2011. The last three Premier League games between Liverpool and Arsenal at Anfield have all been drawn, while the Gunners are winless in their last 12 away games against the Reds since a 2-0 win back in September 2012, with manager Mikel Arteta starting for the Gunners that day.

programme.title: UEFA European Qualifiers World Cup 2026 Preview
programme.desc: The European section of the 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification competition will act as qualifiers for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, to be held in Canada, Mexico and the United States, for national teams that are members of the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA). A total of 16 slots in the final tournament are available for UEFA teams.

programme.title: Olympique Lyonnais vs Olympique Marseille - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match / Olympique Lyonnais vs Olympique Marseille - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini match
programme.desc: Lyon and Marseille will face each other for the 126th time in all competitions, with OM becoming the second most often faced opponent by OL. It will be only their ninth meeting in August, the first since 2005. Lyon have lost five of their last six matches against Marseille in Ligue 1, only one defeat less than in the first 42 meetings between these two teams in the top-flight in the 21st century.

programme.title: Rayo Vallecano vs Barcelona - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Rayo Vallecano have lost their last three LaLiga games against Barcelona, ​​all three since Iñigo Perez’s arrival, after scoring and being unbeaten in each of their previous five against the Catalans in the competition. Barcelona have only won one of their last four LaLiga away games against Rayo Vallecano, after winning their previous six away games against them in the top-flight.

programme.title: Tales, Tears and Trophies - Joe Hart
programme.desc: Former Manchester United, Arsenal and France player Mikael Silvestre hosts a series of interviews with former opponents and team mates. They discuss their motivations and what it’s really like inside dressing rooms at the very highest level.

programme.title: My Faith in Sport - Salah
programme.desc: Exploring the importance of prayer within Islam, the episode begins with an overview of our seven athletes as they introduce themselves and why Islam is so important to them. We are also introduced to Omar Sulieman, a notable Imam, who acts as narration throughout the series and a guiding voice on the key principles of Islam. The life and career of Sofyan Amrabat is explored, showcasing his role as a key part of the Fenerbahce team in Turkey and the Moroccan national side. The Atlas Lions’ run to the semi-finals of the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022 is explored, with the impact that Salah played in the team’s belief and positivity throughout the tournament.

programme.title: My Faith in Sport - Sawm
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab. Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan.

programme.desc: Dive into the excitement of French handball with Liqui Moly Starligue, formerly LNH Division 1. Established in 1952, this premier league event features 16 top teams battling for glory. With Montpellier’s 14 Handball titles and Paris Saint-Germains 11 wins, the competition is fierce. Champions earn spots in the EHF Champions League, while cup winners qualify for the European League.

programme.title: Nikola karabatic 20 Years Of Glory
programme.desc: Renowned as one of the greatest handball players of the century, Nikola retires on May 31 after his final game with PSG Handball. His career concludes with the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. A four-time World Champion, three-time Olympic gold medalist, and three-time World Handball Player of the Year, Nikola plans to take a break from his career to spend more time with his family.

programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 317 / MMA UFC 317
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football - Scotland League: Rangers - Celtic / Fudbal - Škotska liga: Rangers - Celtic
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship in its first season has set out in 1890. years and has already been set up by one rarity. programme.title: Basketball - KLS: FMP - Zlatibor, G2 / Košarka - KLS: FMP - Zlatibor, G2
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and coaches. / Seria A je profesionalno fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 ekipa u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Elche - Levante / Fudbal - Španska liga: Elche - Levante
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Borac - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Borac - Široki Brijeg
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Final: Partizan - Budućnost G4 / Košarka - ABA liga: Finale: Partizan - Budućnost G4
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Sailor - Cibona / Košarka - ABA liga: Mornar - Cibona
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Football - Croatian League: Hajduk - Rijeka / Fudbal - Hrvatska liga: Hajduk - Rijeka
programme.desc: The Croatian football league was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the competition system and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-circular form of the competition. The transition cup intended for the champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana Earth. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. The absolute recorder in the number of favorites achieved is the legend of Varteks Davor Vugrinec with 144 goals. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se menjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prelazni kup namenjen prvaku delo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. Apsolutni rekorder po broju postignutih pogodaka legenda je Varteksa Davor Vugrinec sa 144 gola.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Borac - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Borac - Široki Brijeg
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Football (M): HSV - St. Pauli, Bundesliga 2025/2026, Hamburg / Nogomet (M): HSV - St. Pauli, Bundesliga 2025/2026 , Hamburg
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, first League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991 after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, first League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991 after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, first League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991 after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Environments, pom. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Not far from Ljubljana, a few years ago, a new house has grown, which was created by "remote". I / Nedaleč od Ljubljane je pred nekaj leti zrasla nova hiša, ki je nastala tako rekoč »na daljavo«. programme.desc: When building or renovating a home, we create not only a building, but a place where we will spend valuable moments with our loved ones, where our children will grow and where memories and traditions that will form future generations will be created. The offsets that affected a large part of Slovenia last August were destroyed by many. The powerful power of water paved the way between the living spaces of unsuspecting people who tried to save what could be solved. Trajnostna gradnja nam omogoča, da oblikujemo naše okolje na odgovoren, trajen in zdrav način. Razložimo, kako lahko to dosežemo.Poplave, ki so avgusta lani prizadele velik del Slovenije, so marsikomu uničile dom. Silna moč vode si je utirala pot med bivalnimi prostori nič hudega slutečih ljudi, ki so skušali rešiti, kar se je rešiti dalo. Tudi pritličje vrstne hiše je bilo v poplavah močno uničeno, a po zaslugi zglednega sodelovanja med oblikovalko interjerja ter lastnikoma, dandanes riše nasmehe in zadovoljstvo na obraz vsem vpletenim.

programme.title: Matija Vertovec, Great Mind of the Slovenian nation, documentary, Mon. / Matija Vertovec, veliki um slovenskega naroda, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Naberšnik Marko ... Matija Vertovec was a priest, chemist, geographer, historian, starter, preacher, polyglot and the first teacher of Slovenian winegrowers. / R: Naberšnik Marko... Matija Vertovec je bil duhovnik, kemik, geograf, zgodovinar, zvezdoslovec, pridigar, poliglot in prvi učitelj slovenskih vinogradnikov.
programme.desc: He was the great mind of the Slovenian nation and the folk teacher from the beginning of the 19th century, whose teachings are still very topical after 200 years. What is his heritage, the three theologians and a young priest are discovered, who embark on the path of research with the only preserved Vertovec photo. Yet the documentary is not a reconstruction of the life of a portrait. The narrative is based on a picture of modern times, which through the stories of the main protagonists becomes so alive that it offers us an insight into the time of Matija Vertovec. In addition to the lead biographical story, the documentary at the same time detects the priesthood profession, and the young researchers meet with Vertovc's relatives, locals and experts who each continue their work of the great man. Few people know that Matija Vertovec was the one who addressed Prešeren to Zdravljica's record and encouraged Peter Kozlar to produce a map of Slovenian lands. He was the first to write in Slovene about viticulture and cellar, about useful chemistry, astronomy and general world history. He informed the locals across the Vipava Valley about the benefits of vaccination over black goats, thus defending them against death. He agreed with the French authorities and saved Vipava's payments of high taxes, he was a man of practical exploration, and unlike most priests of his time, who were inserting from the pulpit, he went to compatriots and invested a lot of energy into the education of simple people. / Bil je veliki um slovenskega naroda in ljudski učitelj z začetka 19. stoletja, čigar nauki so po 200 letih še vedno zelo aktualni. Kakšna je njegova dediščina, odkrivajo trije bogoslovci in mlad duhovnik, ki se na pot raziskovanja odpravijo z edino ohranjeno Vertovčevo fotografijo. Pa vendar dokumentarni film ni rekonstrukcija življenja portretiranca. Pripoved temelji na sliki sodobnega časa, ki skozi zgodbe glavnih protagonistov postane tako živa, da nam ponuja vpogled v čas Matije Vertovca. Dokumentarni film poleg vodilne biografske zgodbe hkrati detabuizira duhovniški poklic, mladi raziskovalci pa se srečajo z Vertovčevimi sorodniki, domačini in strokovnjaki, ki vsak po svoje nadaljujejo delo velikega človeka. Le malokdo ve, da je bil prav Matija Vertovec tisti, ki je Prešerna nagovoril k zapisu Zdravljice, Petra Kozlarja pa vzpodbudil k izdelavi Zemljevida slovenskih dežel. Bil je prvi, ki je v slovenskem jeziku pisal o vinogradništvu in kletarjenju, o uporabni kemiji, o astronomiji in o splošni svetovni zgodovini. Domačine širom Vipavske doline je informiral o prednostih cepljenja pred črnimi kozami in jih tako ubranil pred smrtjo. S francosko oblastjo se je pogodil in Vipavce rešil plačevanja visokih davkov, bil je človek praktičnega raziskovanja, za razliko od večine duhovnikov njegovega časa, ki so žugali s prižnice, pa je hodil med rojake in veliko energije vložil v izobraževanje preprostih ljudi.

programme.title: The Beckenbauer - Pools of Superlative / Die Beckenbauer - Pools der Superlative
programme.desc: With its great structures, the rough surface is ideal for a waterfall and you can walk well on the smooth side. That is why the Beckenbauer in Sarasota work with limestone rocks. Stable pond liner and fiber concrete are used in Florida. Lucas Congdon and his team take over 200 cubic meters of earth in their customer's garden to make room for a natural oasis. Because Frank Giuffre and his wife Heather would like a mixture of pool and pond where you can relax. In each episode of the reality series, the construction of a pool is accompanied, from planning to the magical moment in which the finished pool is extended. / Die raue Oberflache eignet sich mit ihren tollen Strukturen hervorragend fur einen Wasserfall und auf der glatten Seite kann man prima laufen. Deshalb arbeiten die Beckenbauer in Sarasota mit Kalksteinfels. Daruber hinaus kommen in Florida stabile Teichfolie und Faserbeton zum Einsatz. Lucas Congdon und sein Team heben dort im Garten ihres Kunden uber 200 Kubikmeter Erde aus, um Platz fur eine naturliche Oase zu schaffen. Denn Frank Giuffre und seine Frau Heather wunschen sich eine Mischung aus Pool und Teich, in der man herrlich relaxen kann.Lucas Congdon und seine Firma "Lucas Lagoons" bauen die abgefahrensten Swimmingpools, die man sich vorstellen kann. In jeder Folge der Reality-Serie wird der Bau eines Pools begleitet, von der Planung bis hin zu dem magischen Moment, in dem der fertige Pool enthullt wird.

programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: In this episode, the aquarium professionals build an underwater world for the Bellagio Hotel in Las Vegas. There, an exhibition on the topic "under the ocean" is opened in a short time. The managers of the luxury hostel have ordered two huge pools with 5700 liters of water from the professional craftsmen, which form a walk-in tunnel in the main course. The construction delivers super cool photo motifs. Due to the LED lighting and reflective film, when looking at the colorful tropical fish, you have the impression that you are most large for hours on the sea floor, large, bigger! Commercial room aquariums are also nice, but Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little to do with 10 liter basins. Your specialty are breathtaking underwater worlds! From the octagonal eco system with murans and stingrays over the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's practice: there is almost no idea that the boys do not dare to do. And their super aquariums not only like the underwater residents very well, but also the audience. Wherever the board and wayde always pretend to the public, people do not get out of amazement / In dieser Folge bauen die Aquarium-Profis eine Unterwasserwelt fur das Bellagio-Hotel in Las Vegas. Dort wird in Kurze eine Ausstellung zum Thema "Unter dem Ozean" eroffnet. Die Manager der Luxusherberge haben bei den Profi-Handwerkern zwei riesige Becken mit jeweils 5700 Litern Wasser bestellt, die im Hauptgang einen begehbaren Tunnel bilden. Die Konstruktion liefert supercoole Fotomotive. Denn aufgrund der LED-Beleuchtung und reflektierender Folie hat man beim Betrachten der bunten Tropenfische den Eindruck, man stunde direkt auf dem Meeresgrund.Gross, grosser, am grossten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10 Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Öko-System mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arzt-Praxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen.Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasser-Bewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum.Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihrer beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus

programme.title: Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick looks at a very valuable Pokemon collection. In addition, the Harrison is offered a table lighter in the form of a clock from 1926. In the time of the "great depression", the United States was almost flooded with pawns in which humans put their belongings in payment to get cash quickly and unurocratic. The depression went, the idea was preserved. The reality series "The three from the Pfandhaus" accompanies the Harrison family, which has been running such a pawn house in Las Vegas since 1988. The spectators can experience what unusual objects go with the Harrison's over the counter and how difficult it is for company grans Richard Harrison, his son Rick and his son Corey to shake the value of things. In addition to historical machines, weapons from the Second World War, rare autographs from the 1950s and computers from the eighties, there can also be a luxury classic car. / Rick sieht sich eine sehr wertvolle Pokemon-Sammlung an. Ausserdem wird den Harrisons ein Tischfeuerzeug in Form einer Uhr von 1926 angeboten.In der Zeit der "Grossen Depression" wurden die USA geradezu uberschwemmt mit Pfandleihhausern, in denen Menschen ihre Habseligkeiten in Zahlung gaben, um schnell und unburokratisch an Bargeld zu kommen. Die Depression ging, die Idee blieb erhalten. Die Realityserie "Die Drei vom Pfandhaus" begleitet Familie Harrison, die seit 1988 in Las Vegas ein solches Pfandleihhaus betreibt. Die Zuschauer konnen erleben, welch ungewohnliche Objekte bei den Harrisons uber den Ladentisch gehen und wie schwierig es fur Firmengrunder Richard Harrison, seinen Sohn Rick und dessen Sohn Corey manchmal ist, den Wert der Dinge zu schatzen. Neben historischen Automaten, Waffen aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg, seltenen Autogrammen aus den 50er Jahren und Computern aus den Achtzigern kann da auch schon mal ein Luxus-Oldtimer dabei sein.

programme.title: From love and life after abuse / Vom Lieben und Leben nach dem Missbrauch

Nachdem sie als kleines Madchen mehrere Jahre sexuell missbraucht wurde, waren Intimitat und Liebesbeziehungen fur immer kontaminiert.Mit siebzig Jahren legt Bracht nun ein Zeugnis ab uber die schwierigen Versuche, weiter zu lieben und Vertrauen zu fassen. Ihre biografische Erzahlung verwebt sie mit philosophischen und soziologischen Diskursen um sexuelle Freiheit und Gleichberechtigung und zeigt uberzeugend, warum Kindsmissbrauch und sexuelle Gewalt immer auch gesellschaftliche Themen sind.Barbara Bleisch trifft Helene Bracht zum Gesprach.Wiederholung vom 27. April 2025

programme.title: Einfach retour
programme.sub-title: Jan in the middle of the Hells Angels / Jan in mitten der Hells Angels
programme.desc: It is the last stage: Jan starts in Tarifa, in the Suden Spain - where the Mediterranean hits the Atlantic. From Tarifa, Jan is supposed to find his way back to Switzerland with just 100 euros in pack and without a smartphone. What follows, is a journey through the shimmering heat of Spain. Marbella, Málaga, Madrid - it could be vacation. But Jan has no time for Siesta: he fights for every kilometer. Car stop sometimes works. But suddenly the journey drifts in a different direction: Jan Gerat in the middle of the world of the biker gang. And ends up in the Hells Angels clubhouse without warning. He spends the night in a secret place, between machines and men, which are better not to do, and the jerk trip becomes a sample test. The clock ticks mercilessly. And the money? Will be scarce. What Jan saves is his talent for improvisation: With a brush and paper, he creates works of art that open new ground. Thanks to people who do not question, but simply buy. The last night: a tent, somewhere in nowhere. But the longed -for calm fails - a wild animal shreds Jans backpack, eats the provisions. The last nerve lies blank. A few hours before the finish. Zurich calls - time runs. Is Jan still doing it - or is he experiencing a failure on the home stretch for the first time? / Es ist die letzte Etappe: Jan startet in Tarifa, ganz im Suden Spaniens - dort, wo das Mittelmeer auf den Atlantik trifft. Von Tarifa soll Jan mit nur 100 Euro in Gepack und ohne Smartphone den Weg zuruck in die Schweiz finden.Was folgt, ist eine Reise durch die flirrende Hitze Spaniens. Marbella, Málaga, Madrid - es konnten Ferien sein. Doch Jan hat keine Zeit fur Siesta: Er kampft um jeden Kilometer. Autostopp funktioniert manchmal. Doch plotzlich driftet die Reise in eine andere Richtung: Jan gerat mitten in die Welt der Biker-Gangs. Und landet ohne Vorwarnung im Clubhaus der Hells Angels. Die Nacht verbringt er an einem geheimen Ort, zwischen Maschinen und Mannern, die man besser nicht duzt.Die Ruckreise wird zur Zerreissprobe. Die Uhr tickt erbarmungslos. Und das Geld? Wird knapp. Was Jan rettet, ist sein Improvisationstalent: Mit Pinsel und Papier schafft er Kunstwerke, die ihm neue Wege offnen. Dank Menschen, die nichts hinterfragen, sondern einfach kaufen. Die letzte Nacht: ein Zelt, irgendwo im Nirgendwo. Doch die ersehnte Ruhe bleibt aus - ein wildes Tier zerfetzt Jans Rucksack, frisst den Proviant. Der letzte Nerv liegt blank. Wenige Stunden vor dem Ziel. Zurich ruft - die Zeit lauft. Schafft es Jan noch - oder erlebt er bei «Einfach Retour» zum ersten Mal ein Scheitern auf der Zielgeraden?

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut - Wildnis Abentuer / SRF bi de Lut - Abenteuer Wildnis
programme.sub-title: Outdoor survival: roast a rabbit without a fire? / Outdoor-Survival: Ohne Feuer einen Hasen braten?
programme.desc: The first challenge at adventure wilderness in the Emmental: Who can do the fastest popcorn? The main prize: a fresh rabbit - a valuable source of protein for survival in the wild. Harbout the Valais team tries to make a fire to eat their rabbits, the other two teams are on a wild and natural medicinal plants - be it to refine the deer soup or as soothing medicine against rash. the nature of the Emmental for survival. Whether fire fire, edible plants or prove mental endurance - new inspections are waiting every day. In addition, wild challenges are around the legendary golden hatchet. With the: The sporty family Liechti from Lengnau, three best friends with lust for discovery - and two Valais tufters who want to defy themselves and nature. / Erste Challenge bei Abenteuer-Wildnis im Emmental: Wer kann am schnellsten Popcorn machen? Der Hauptpreis: ein frischer Hase - eine wertvolle Proteinquelle fur das Überleben in der Wildnis.Wahrend das Walliser Team verzweifelt versucht, ein Feuer zu machen, um ihren Hasen zu essen, greifen die anderen beiden Teams auf Wildkrauter und naturliche Heilpflanzen zuruck - sei es zur Verfeinerung der Hirsesuppe oder als lindernde Medizin gegen Hautausschlag.In der dritten Staffel von «Abenteuer Wildnis» kampfen drei Teams sieben Tage lang in der Natur des Emmentals ums Überleben. Ob Feuer entfachen, essbare Pflanzen aufspuren oder mentale Ausdauer beweisen - taglich warten neue Prufungen. Dazu kommen wilde Challenges um das legendare Goldene Beil.Mit dabei: die sportliche Familie Liechti aus Lengnau, drei beste Freundinnen mit Entdeckerlust - und zwei Walliser Tuftler, die sich selbst und der Natur trotzen wollen.

programme.title: Inga Lindstrom: Looking for you / Inga Lindstrom: Auf der Suche nach dir
programme.desc: The young chef Astrid wants to flee a big dream with her boyfriend Lars: his own restaurant in Stockholm. But on the day of the contract signature there is no trace of Lars. Astrid goes a track to a campsite in Öland. There she meets the operator Bjorn and his little daughter Tova. Gradually, surprising details come to light about Lars, but it remains disappearing. Where is he? Bjorn and Tova are waiting for Elin, Bjorn's wife and Tova's mother, who has been on a self -discovery trip across the world for a year. It turns out: Lars and Elin are siblings, and in addition to numerous other properties, the campsite also belongs. He was also married several times. Astrid begins to doubt: she knows the man with whom she wanted to spend her life with? At the same time, her Bjorn and his simple existence are becoming more and more likeable. But just when the two come close, Lars reappears and can plausibly explain his sophisticated disappearance. Astrid is torn back and forth, because now she was finally able to realize her dream with Lars. / Die junge Kochin Astrid will sich mit ihrem Freund Lars einen grossen Traum erfullen: ein eigenes Restaurant in Stockholm. Doch am Tag der Vertragsunterschrift fehlt von Lars jede Spur. Eine Spur fuhrt Astrid zu einem Campingplatz auf Öland. Dort trifft sie den Betreiber Bjorn und dessen kleine Tochter Tova. Nach und nach kommen uberraschende Details uber Lars ans Licht, doch er bleibt verschwunden. Wo steckt er?Bjorn und Tova warten auf Elin, Bjorns Frau und Tovas Mutter, die sich schon seit einem Jahr auf einem Selbstfindungstrip quer durch die Welt befindet. Es stellt sich heraus: Lars und Elin sind Geschwister, und ihm gehort neben zahlreichen anderen Immobilien auch der Campingplatz. Zudem war er auch schon mehrfach verheiratet. Astrid beginnt zu zweifeln: Kennt sie den Mann uberhaupt, mit dem sie ihr Leben verbringen wollte?Zugleich werden ihr Bjorn und sein einfaches Dasein immer sympathischer. Doch gerade, als die beiden sich naherkommen, taucht Lars wieder auf und kann sein plotzliches Verschwinden plausibel erklaren. Astrid ist hin- und hergerissen, denn nun konnte sie endlich ihren Traum mit Lars verwirklichen.

programme.title: Monobloc
programme.desc: The documentary filmmaker and Grimme prize striker Hauke ​​Wendler follows the diverse traces of the monobloc of Europe Uber North America, to the slums in Brazil to the megastades of India and the Savanna of Uganda. He speaks to people whose life are characterized by this stackable, mostly white plastic chair and raises the question: What do you actually need to be happily? A history -critical object history between functionality and protective, capitalism and participation, consumption and recycling. / Der Dokumentarfilmer und Grimmepreistrager Hauke Wendler folgt den vielfaltigen Spuren des Monobloc von Europa uber Nordamerika, in die Slums in Brasilien bis in die Megastadte Indiens und die Savanne Ugandas. Er spricht mit Menschen, deren Leben von diesem stapelbaren, meist weissen Plastikstuhl gepragt sind und wirft dabei die Frage auf: Was braucht man eigentlich, um glucklich zu sein? Eine globalisierungskritische Objektgeschichte zwischen Funktionalitat und Schonheit, Kapitalismus und Teilhabe, Konsum und Recycling.Erstausstrahlung: 26.02.2023

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: The training week in the Mugg circus will soon be over. Numbers and costumes have to sit now. The process is tested. An accident is happening now. Andrea, a girl from the touring warehouse, came under the Rhonrad. She can hardly open her number. Urs «Mugg» Muggli takes it calmly. As a trained alternative practitioner, he makes a “chabis wrap” and is confident that everything is fine again until the premiere. A rainy day in Japan. He falls exactly on the day when the Bolfing family has planned the trip to Murodo. The place is located in the mountains, in the snow, at almost 2400 meters over sea. It can only be reached in groups by bus. Bolfings have already booked this trip from Switzerland and reserved their place in the car. They cannot rebook out of time, they have to continue traveling again the next day. Whether you go on a trip in bad weather? The Bernhard family changes the place after a week of vacation. In Oster Hurup you now live together with Andreas' parents who traveled from Switzerland. They are mainly there to relieve Andreas and Tanja so that they can do a little alone. The parents of Gina, Jana and Leena are happy to take this opportunity: they take a day trip to Goteborg in Sweden. In the moments of togetherness, they can take a deep breath, charge the batteries and then immerse themselves in everyday family life. / Die Trainingswoche im Zirkus Mugg ist bald vorbei. Nummern und Kostume mussen jetzt sitzen. Die Ablaufe werden durchgeprobt. Ausgerechnet jetzt passiert ein Unfall. Andrea, einem Madchen vom Tourneelager, ist der Finger unter das Rhonrad gekommen. Sie kann ihre Nummer kaum noch auffuhren. Urs «Mugg» Muggli nimmts gelassen. Als gelernter Heilpraktiker macht er einen «Chabiswickel» und ist zuversichtlich, dass bis zur Premiere alles wieder in Ordnung ist.Ein Regentag in Japan. Er fallt genau auf den Tag, an dem Familie Bolfing den Ausflug nach Murodo geplant hat. Der Ort liegt in den Bergen, im Schnee, auf fast 2400 Metern uber Meer. Er ist nur in Gruppen mit einem Bus erreichbar. Bolfings haben diese Reise schon von der Schweiz aus gebucht und ihre Platze im Car reserviert. Umbuchen konnen sie aus zeitlichen Grunden nicht, sie mussen am nachsten Tag wieder weiterreisen. Ob sie auch bei schlechtem Wetter auf den Ausflug gehen?Familie Bernhard wechselt nach einer Woche Ferien den Ort. In Oster Hurup wohnen sie nun zusammen mit den Eltern von Andreas, die aus der Schweiz angereist sind. Sie sind vor allem zur Entlastung von Andreas und Tanja da, damit sie auch einmal etwas alleine unternehmen konnen. Diese Gelegenheit nehmen die Eltern von Gina, Jana und Leena gerne wahr: sie machen einen Tagesausflug nach Goteborg in Schweden. In den Momenten der Zweisamkeit konnen sie durchatmen, die Batterien aufladen und danach wieder voller Energie in den Familienalltag eintauchen.

programme.title: Österreichs historische Gartenpracht
programme.desc: Die historischen Garten Österreichs: bluhende Zeitkapseln, in denen Geschichte lebendig geblieben ist. Filmische Einblicke in das Gartenpalais Liechtenstein, den revitalisierten Landschaftsgarten Grafenegg und den barocken Lustgarten von Schloss Herberstein.

programme.title: Katie Fforde: Zimmer mit Meerblick
programme.desc: Julia Gardener of all people is said to have fallen for a marriage crash? A school director blindly trusts in her life and has to regret the bitterly. The tough New Yorker Julia has achieved everything professionally and always under control, only in love it doesn't run smoothly. After a violent structure, she has to decide whether she wants to get involved in the love adventure again. programme.title: Einfach retour
programme.sub-title: Jan in the middle of the Hells Angels / Jan in mitten der Hells Angels
programme.desc: It is the last stage: Jan starts in Tarifa, in the Suden Spain - where the Mediterranean hits the Atlantic. From Tarifa, Jan is supposed to find his way back to Switzerland with just 100 euros in pack and without a smartphone. What follows, is a journey through the shimmering heat of Spain. Marbella, Málaga, Madrid - it could be vacation. But Jan has no time for Siesta: he fights for every kilometer. Car stop sometimes works. But suddenly the journey drifts in a different direction: Jan Gerat in the middle of the world of the biker gang. And ends up in the Hells Angels clubhouse without warning. He spends the night in a secret place, between machines and men, which are better not to do, and the jerk trip becomes a sample test. The clock ticks mercilessly. And the money? Will be scarce. What Jan saves is his talent for improvisation: With a brush and paper, he creates works of art that open new ground. Thanks to people who do not question, but simply buy. The last night: a tent, somewhere in nowhere. But the longed -for calm fails - a wild animal shreds Jans backpack, eats the provisions. The last nerve lies blank. A few hours before the finish. Zurich calls - time runs. Is Jan still doing it - or is he experiencing a failure on the home stretch for the first time? / Es ist die letzte Etappe: Jan startet in Tarifa, ganz im Suden Spaniens - dort, wo das Mittelmeer auf den Atlantik trifft. Von Tarifa soll Jan mit nur 100 Euro in Gepack und ohne Smartphone den Weg zuruck in die Schweiz finden.Was folgt, ist eine Reise durch die flirrende Hitze Spaniens. Marbella, Málaga, Madrid - es konnten Ferien sein. Doch Jan hat keine Zeit fur Siesta: Er kampft um jeden Kilometer. Autostopp funktioniert manchmal. Doch plotzlich driftet die Reise in eine andere Richtung: Jan gerat mitten in die Welt der Biker-Gangs. Und landet ohne Vorwarnung im Clubhaus der Hells Angels. Die Nacht verbringt er an einem geheimen Ort, zwischen Maschinen und Mannern, die man besser nicht duzt.Die Ruckreise wird zur Zerreissprobe. Die Uhr tickt erbarmungslos. Und das Geld? Wird knapp. Was Jan rettet, ist sein Improvisationstalent: Mit Pinsel und Papier schafft er Kunstwerke, die ihm neue Wege offnen. Dank Menschen, die nichts hinterfragen, sondern einfach kaufen. Die letzte Nacht: ein Zelt, irgendwo im Nirgendwo. Doch die ersehnte Ruhe bleibt aus - ein wildes Tier zerfetzt Jans Rucksack, frisst den Proviant. Der letzte Nerv liegt blank. Wenige Stunden vor dem Ziel. Zurich ruft - die Zeit lauft. Schafft es Jan noch - oder erlebt er bei «Einfach Retour» zum ersten Mal ein Scheitern auf der Zielgeraden?

programme.title: Samschtig-Jass

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: A good 20 years ago, Jean-Marc and Emiko Bolfing met during a voice stay in England. Emiko left her home and came to Switzerland with Jean-Marc. As a Japanese woman, she is used to keeping back and modesty. In Switzerland, she had to learn to say her opinion and stand up for herself. Now Sarah, the 16-year daughter of the Bolfings, goes to America for a year. The parents come up with memories of their language stay. The visit to the Legoland on the holiday agenda, something that the children are particularly looking forward to is still looking at their own expectations and fears of back then. The adults are aware that this day for their two daughter becomes a challenge with autism: many people in one place, many impressions, lamp and unforeseen. But the children are not there for the first time, four years ago, on their last holidays in Danemark, they were already in Legoland. The last performance of the touring camp from the Mugg circus takes place in Glarus on the fence site, in front of a wonderful mountain backdrop. On the last day, all young people have to pack their things, put the cars up and clean. Then put yourself in your stuff again for the Dernière. The joy after the show is great, but briefly. Now comes the demolition of the circus city and then the farewell. The youngsters drive home and Mugg back to Betschwanden with the circus cars. The Muggli family now has more time to devote themselves to their own family - maybe even travel on vacation for a few days? / Vor gut 20 Jahren haben sich Jean-Marc und Emiko Bolfing bei einem Sprachaufenthalt in England kennen gelernt. Emiko hat ihre Heimat verlassen und ist mit Jean-Marc in die Schweiz gekommen. Als Japanerin ist sie sich Zuruckhaltung und Bescheidenheit gewohnt. In der Schweiz musste sie lernen, ihre Meinung zu sagen und fur sich einzustehen. Nun geht Sarah, die 16-jahrige Tochter der Bolfings, fur ein Jahr nach Amerika. Bei den Eltern kommen Erinnerungen an ihren Sprachaufenthalt hoch. Ihre eigenen Erwartungen und Ängste von damals.Bevor die Familie Bernhard wieder heimreist, steht noch der Besuch im Legoland auf der Ferienagenda, etwas, auf das sich die Kinder besonders freuen. Die Erwachsenen sind sich bewusst, dass dieser Tag fur ihre beiden Tochter mit Autismus eine Herausforderung wird: viele Menschen an einem Ort, viele Eindrucke, Larm und Unvorhergesehenes. Doch die Kinder sind nicht zum ersten Mal dort, vor vier Jahren, bei ihren letzten Ferien in Danemark, waren sie bereits im Legoland.Die letzte Vorstellung des Tourneelagers vom Zirkus Mugg findet in Glarus auf dem Zaunplatz statt, vor wunderbarer Bergkulisse. Am letzten Tag mussen alle Jugendlichen ihre Sachen packen, die Wagen aufraumen und putzen. Dann legen sie sich noch einmal richtig ins Zeug fur die Dernière. Die Freude nach der Show ist gross, aber kurz. Jetzt kommt der Abbruch der Zirkus-Stadt und dann der Abschied. Die Jugendlichen fahren nach Hause und Mugg mit den Zirkuswagen zuruck nach Betschwanden. Familie Muggli hat jetzt wieder mehr Zeit, sich der eigenen Familie zu widmen - vielleicht sogar ein paar Tage in die Ferien zu verreisen?
